title: AI & Automation Engineer
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology, and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Cyber Security Engineering team is seeking a dynamic AI & Automation Engineer to build and support the critical technologies that enable our Information Security and Incident Response teams. Operating in a highly collaborative, hybrid Agile/Scrum environment, you will leverage Python and Golang to develop robust scripting, orchestrate tasks within Cortex XSOAR, and streamline complex security operations. Beyond traditional SOAR engineering, you will play a pivotal role in our AI enablement journey by exploring, securing, and implementing cutting-edge technologies like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agent-to-Agent communications, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We are looking for a strong software engineer with a passion for learning emerging AI concepts who can effectively partner with cross-functional teams to automate our defenses and accelerate incident response.
Responsibilities:
Automation Script Development:  Write, maintain, and optimize efficient scripts using Python and Golang to automate routine security and incident response tasks.
SOAR Platform Orchestration:  Develop and manage playbooks, workflows, and integrations within the Cortex XSOAR platform to accelerate incident resolution.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner closely with security analysts and cross-functional stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver impactful solutions.
Agile Sprint Participation:  Actively engage in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to ensure continuous delivery within our Agile framework.
AI Implementation Support:  Assist in designing and implementing emerging AI technologies, including RAG architectures, to enhance security team capabilities.
Agent Communication Design:  Build and test reliable Agent-to-Agent communication workflows that support intelligent, automated decision-making processes.
MCP Integration Support:  Assist in the development, integration, and security of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to standardize our AI interactions.
API Integration Management : Connect disparate internal systems and third-party security tools using robust RESTful API integrations.
Continuous Technology Learning:  Dedicate time to researching and experimenting with the latest advancements in AI and automation to identify new operational efficiencies.
Code Testing Review:  Conduct peer code reviews and implement automated testing to maintain a high-quality, secure, and reliable codebase.
Technical Documentation Creation:  Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for developed scripts, playbooks, and AI integrations to ensure team-wide knowledge sharing.
Required:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field plus 5 years’ experience; Or Master’s Degree plus 4 years’ experience.
Respective years of related work experience in software engineering, automation, or integration development.
Strong proficiency in programming and scripting languages, specifically Python and Golang.
Proven experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs for complex system integrations.
Demonstrated capability and enthusiastic interest in learning new technologies, specifically in the AI space (e.g., LLMs, RAG, MCP).
Experience working effectively within an Agile/Scrum development methodology.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational needs into technical solutions.
Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, version control (e.g., Git), and code testing principles.
Ability to work successfully in a hybrid work environment.
Preferred:
Hands-on experience with Cortex XSOAR or similar SOAR platforms (e.g., Splunk SOAR, Tines).
Prior exposure to or foundational knowledge of AI frameworks, RAG implementations, or Agent-to-Agent communications.
Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles or incident response workflows (prior security experience is not required, but an interest is a plus).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
Experience with containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.

title: Account Specialist, Migraine - Cleveland, OH
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose
Describe the primary goals, objectives or functions or outputs of this position.
The Account Specialist role promotes a product to community practices and health systems. Customer accounts may include community/private practices, community-based hospitals, academic medical centers, and government accounts (military treatment facilities and/or Veteran’s Affairs Medical Centers). The Account Specialist develops and maintains relationships with various accounts/departments such as neurology, pain medicine, physical medicine and rehabilitation, primary care, and pharmacy. Or in Urology, specialists such as urology, urogynecology, obstetrics and gynecology, female pelvic medicine, ambulatory surgical centers, and reconstructive surgery.
Responsibilities
Promote a product to meet/exceed sales goals in community/private practices as well as hospitals/health systems.
Identify/uncover customer needs (training, clinical, operational, reimbursement) and address with appropriate AbbVie resources
Provide education and clinical/injection training for residents, fellows, and other key hospital personnel.
Expert delivery of anatomical/procedural information and training, including the appropriate use of anatomical terminology to train injection paradigms/postures while highlighting various anatomical and injection insights and considerations.
Effectively utilize AbbVie's sales and data resources to enhance productivity and growth of AbbVie products while implementing U.S. Marketing Plan.
Collaborate with other Account Specialist to promote the product for approved indications and execute individual, department, or group resident/fellow trainings within hospital/health system accounts.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of technical experience with three (3) or more years of experience within sales preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
Experience with Buy & Bill and/or Specialty Pharmacy products is preferred, in both health systems and private practice
Ability to lift/pull 25–100 lb. training models and meet necessary hospital credentialing/vaccination requirements
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings
Documented history of strong sales performance, preferably in a clinical/technical/consultative sales role with multiple decision makers is preferred. Ability to manage a complex sell, learn procedural, technical, clinical, and anatomical information quickly and communicate/present/train to a variety of audiences
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. description:

The Architect, Technology I owns the architecture of the enterprise cloud data platform and leads a team of developers, working with limited supervision. The role also directs a very large offshore team across multiple time zones, setting technical direction, standards, and roadmaps so work stays consistent at scale. The architect applies advanced technical knowledge to complex assignments, independently leads technical components of larger initiatives, and supports business growth and technology integration in a regulated environment.
Responsibilities:
Perform technical and analytical tasks using established methods and tools; apply judgment to adapt approaches for less-routine problems, document methods and results, and escalate novel or ambiguous issues with suggested next steps.
Lead and mentor a team of developers, and direct a large offshore team, setting priorities, coordinating handoffs across time zones, and holding delivery to quality and architecture standards.
Review design artifacts and enforce standards through peer reviews, architecture principles, and documented compliance evidence. Support governance and compliance tracking by maintaining architecture repositories, updating standards documentation, and coordinating audit preparations.
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams on implementation by providing architecture guidance, reviewing technical designs, and validating integration points.
Define and evolve data platform architecture, including Lakehouse, data mesh and data fabric patterns, event-driven designs, and batch and real-time processing.
Establish data contracts, data quality, observability, lineage, and metadata practices for reusable data products and platform services.
Design for scalability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, security, and cost optimization.
Identify automation and process improvements by evaluating tooling options, implementing validation scripts, and streamlining documentation workflows.
Maintain architecture documentation and guidelines by updating models, capturing design decisions, and keeping them accessible to project teams.
Deliver reliable outputs for assigned and moderately complex projects; ensure acceptance criteria and compliance requirements are met, document methods, validations, and key assumptions, and keep project leads, stakeholders, and leadership informed of progress and issues.
Required:
Bachelor’s Degree 7 years of experience, or Master’s Degree 6 years of experience, or PhD 2 years of experience.
Significant hands-on experience building and operationalizing enterprise-scale cloud big data platforms.
Strong knowledge of modern data engineering architectures, including cloud-native data platforms, Lakehouse architecture, data mesh and data fabric concepts, event driven architectures, and batch and real-time data processing.
Familiarity with open table formats and interoperable data ecosystems, such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
Experience building reliable data pipelines, data products, and reusable platform services.
Knowledge of data quality, observability, lineage, metadata management, and data governance.
Experience defining and implementing data contracts covering schemas, semantics, quality expectations, ownership, and access policies.
Understanding of data security, privacy, identity and access management, encryption, regulatory requirements, and responsible data use.
Experience designing for scalability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
Familiarity with modern data development and orchestration tools, such as dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or comparable technologies.
Experience with serverless architectures including Kubernetes, AWS EKS, and AWS Fargate.
Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction across teams.
Demonstrated ability to mentor technical staff, lead cross-functional teams, and drive initiatives to completion.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to operate with high autonomy and minimal supervision, proactively managing stakeholder expectations and keeping leadership informed through clear, concise verbal and written communication.
Preferred
Exposure to or experience with Cloudera Data Platform or another legacy big-data environment (a significant plus).
Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or other highly regulated environments.
Experience working with international development teams across multiple time zones.
Exposure to graph databases and GraphQL.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Process Engineer
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose statement
Own and evolve the clinical process engineering capability within Clinical Development Operations, establishing the methodology, standards, and governance infrastructure that enable scalable, inspection-ready, and operationally excellent processes across the enterprise. The Associate Director, Clinical Process Engineer is the functional authority on process design and engineering practice, operating at the intersection of strategy, compliance, and execution. This role shapes how the discipline works, not just what it delivers, and is accountable for building the infrastructure and talent that sustains the capability long-term. Operates within a multilayered leadership structure and is expected to bring enterprise-level judgment and strong upward credibility.
Major responsibilities
Define and own the clinical process engineering methodology, standards, and toolset used across Clinical Development Operations; drive adoption and continuous evolution of the practice.
Serve as the enterprise subject matter authority on clinical process design, advising senior and executive leadership on process strategy, capability investments, and cross-functional process architecture.
Oversee the design and governance of end-to-end clinical processes across the enterprise; ensure coherence, scalability, and inspection readiness across domains and programs.
Lead enterprise-level current-state assessments and strategic process analyses; translate findings into capability recommendations and program-level improvement roadmaps for executive audiences.
Design and lead high-stakes, enterprise-wide process workshops and governance forums; manage executive-level stakeholder dynamics, resolve competing priorities, and drive strategic alignment.
Establish and own the process compliance, inspection readiness, and quality-by-design frameworks for the function; proactively manage risk and partner with quality and regulatory leadership on emerging expectations.
Lead and govern complex, cross-enterprise process-to-system programs; accountable for the quality and integrity of process design inputs feeding technology platforms and transformation initiatives.
Own the process performance measurement framework for the function; define enterprise KPIs, oversee reporting infrastructure, and present insights to senior leadership and governance bodies.
Set and govern documentation standards, decision record practices, and process governance infrastructure across Clinical Development Operations; responsible for audit readiness at a function-wide level.
May manage 0–5 direct reports; responsible for team leadership, talent strategy, performance management, and building a differentiated, high-impact process engineering capability.
Bachelor's degree in engineering, life sciences, business, or a related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.

The Immunology Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) acts as an alternative in-office resource that is available to address HCP questions about patient access.  The FRM calls directly on HCP offices in their assigned, specific geography to answer questions about patient access & reimbursement in support of the AbbVie immunology portfolio.  The FRM provides expertise on coverage and common access and reimbursement challenges affecting AbbVie immunology products.  The FRM responsibilities include educating on the access and reimbursement support tools available from Abbvie, advising HCPs on patient prescription status and program eligibility, and educating HCP offices on payer processes and procedures.
Specific Responsibilities:
Educate HCPs on patient support programs, including access and reimbursement support tools and services
Educate on product-specific acquisition and access options such as specialty pharmacy networks, specialty distribution, and white-bagging support
Educate on resources available to address access issues
Provide local expertise in regards to national/regional payor policies in order to educate providers on payer issues, coding changes, and appropriate claims submission processes
Liaise with Abbvie’s Access and Reimbursement support center to update HCPs on Rx status and program eligibility
Report back payer trends related for approved products to Patient Services and Market Access account management teams
Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate providers within territory
Remain current on key managed care, reimbursement, and policy activities
At least 3 years of experience in immunology with experience in Market Access, Payer Account Management, and/or Access and Reimbursement
Thorough understanding of the technical payer policy processes, systems and requirements for coverage, coding and payment for specialty medicines
Demonstrated understanding of the rules, regulations and risks associated with provision of reimbursement support services
Strong understanding and ability to communicate technical elements of coding and billing requirements at the National and Regional level across all settings of care
Comprehensive understanding of Parts A, B, C and D or Medicare and associated reimbursement dynamics
Strong understanding of drug acquisition and dispensing in the immunology specialty biologics space (Buy and Bill, Specialty Pharmacies, Specialty Distributors, etc.)
Strong understanding of access and reimbursement support service centers and how to effectively interact in a compliant fashion
Excellent territory and account management skills
Bachelor’s degree
Valid driver’s license
Additional Qualifications:
5 or more years of industry experience in access and reimbursement or account management
Extensive experience educating others on payer processes, requirement for coverage, and other access related situations for specialty medicines
Strong track record of leadership within current role

title: Finance Manager - Skincare
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The primary objective of this position is to lead the Finance team for US Skincare, comprised of SkinMedica, Diamond Glow and Latisse as well as upcoming pipeline assets. The position is responsible for driving the development, maintenance, harmonization, and continuous improvement of the forecast models used to produce commercial revenue projections for all Planning Cycles (LBEs, Plan, LRP, ADS) and launch assessments as well as P&L management, financial controls, project management, associated analytics and supporting presentation materials for review with US Allergan Aesthetics (AA) Commercial and Finance as well as AbbVie leadership.
The individual must develop and maintain a strong knowledge of the business to facilitate optimal decision making through cross-functional collaboration with various teams such as Marketing, Sales, MABI, Global Commercial Development (GCD), Field Force Operations, Incentive Compensation, Pricing, Gross-to-Net and Loyalty Programs, Commercial Finance, Operations, Customer Service and FSS. This highly visible role offers opportunities to interact with all levels of the organization, including senior leadership in AA and Finance.
Responsibilities:
Lead the US Skincare Finance team including managing direct reports, coaching and people development.
Lead the P&L management as well as Demand and Revenue forecasting process for US Skincare.
Own and continuously improve driver-based demand and revenue forecasting models for US Skincare, ensuring timely, accurate, and decision-relevant outputs across all planning cycles.
Drive US Skincare projects to achieve commercial objectives and financial controls.
Translate complex financial and commercial insights into clear executive narratives and recommendations, while ensuring compliance with applicable financial, legal, and corporate requirements.
Identify key insights from data analysis, highlighting trends, opportunities, and risks.
Develop and drive solutions/strategies to enhance operational performance and address issues faced by the business.
Financial Planning & Analysis and Reporting:
Lead the execution of LBEs, Plan, LRP, ADS and S&OP forecasts by aligning with cross-functional stakeholders such as Commercial, Finance and Operations.
P&L management, including standard margin, OMC, OCOGS and SG&A.
Oversee the SG&A, headcount, and CAPEX for US Skincare.
Lead the monthly demand review, analyze forecasting trends, forecast accuracy, and the forecast proposal with various stakeholders such as Commercial and Global Operations.
Preparation and submission of the Plan, LBEs, LRP, ADS and S&OP and their related supporting documentation including timely, accurate and complete preparation of all requested documents and backups for corresponding meeting reviews.
Develop realistic forecasts by channel, monitor drivers of performance, historical trends, and market dynamics to analyze performance, and leverage multiple sources of data such as market data, promotional activities, in-field insights, analytics, channel evolution as well as market events to identify patterns, compare with market trends and drive accuracy and predictability of results and key metrics.
Apply technical expertise to refine forecasting models, supporting strategic business decisions.
Develop forecasts by understanding key drivers of performance across channels, customers, tiers as well as analyzing volume/SKU mix trends.
Collaborate with stakeholders to validate and integrate actuals into forecasting models, ensuring integrity and accuracy.
Develop revenue targets for the sales force in coordination with the Incentive Compensation team.
Develop and maintain financial forecasts for upcoming assets to drive successful launch planning, and execution.
Develop and maintain financial scenario models through robust understanding of business insights and drivers of performance for revenue and investment analysis, including development of business cases, promotional offers, P&L forecasts, profitability, and ROI analysis as well as RCEs.
Lead investment analysis including cross-brand portfolio financial management.
Compile comprehensive reports and presentations, distilling market dynamics and financial outcomes as well as present sales results and future forecasts to Commercial, providing strategic context.
Prepare financial reports such as sales roll-forward, key opportunities and risks, PPD schedules vs benchmarks with clear narratives and back-up support.
Prepare ad-hoc financial analysis to support informed decision making.
Business Partnering:
Engage with cross-functional teams to address business challenges, offering strategic financial insights and solutions.
Facilitate effective communication with management on forecast processes, issues, and strategic rationale.
Partner with Global Operations (e.g. Brand Operations, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP) to align supply and demand forecasts, optimizing inventory, E&O and cash flow.
Coordinate with GCD and MABI to stay informed on competitor activities and market developments.
Liaison for US Skincare with various teams such as Gross-to-Net and Loyalty Programs, Field Force Operations, Incentive Compensation, Operations, FSS and Customer Service.
Actively participate in driving continuous process improvement, refining forecasting processes to enhance data analysis efficiency and communication.
Collaborate on ad hoc analyses involving business performance issues, providing clear resolutions.
Prepare reports to support earnings calls and external communications.
Support ad hoc requests, lead projects, and participate in corporate initiatives.
8 years of combined experience in Commercial Finance, P&L management, revenue forecasting, financial planning and analysis, cost accounting, auditing, and financial reporting is required. Forecasting, project management and prior pharmaceutical or consumer industry experience preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in finance or accounting.
Leadership skills, capability to direct efforts to achieve answers and results.
Strong financial, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and presentation skills.
Ability to think creatively and strategically, identify key issues, opportunities, and value drivers to effectively translate strategic insights into appropriate forecasts to drive business decisions.
Ability to understand market research to assess and quantify financial impacts of marketing initiatives, promotional activities, and competitive events.
Ability to triangulate a wide variety of data sets and analytics to inform forecasting and solve business problems through the proactive identification of issues and subsequent collection, analysis, and interpretation of related data.
Ability to lead teams and manage multiple tasks concurrently in a dynamic environment and ensure production of high quality and timely work product.
Ability to gain alignment and partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders across varying levels of management and “influence without direct authority”.
Experience in working in a dynamic business environment under tight timelines and quick turnarounds to successfully achieve results/deliverables.
Demonstrated self-starter that communicates actions, decisions, and concerns in a timely and effective manner.
Understanding of AbbVie’s financial policies (CFMs) as well as Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.
Solid understanding of systems and automation tools such as SAP, BPC, Power BI, Excel.
AI Automation capabilities a plus.

Job Description
The Finance Lead/Supervisor drives the financial planning and analysis processes and requirements across businesses supporting planning and actuals analysis/reporting requirements for the Product Development, Science & Technology (PDS&T) business unit within Operations Finance.  This role will provide accurate and timely financial analysis and planning deliverables to meet requirements.
Responsibilities
Operates independently to prepare relevant variance analysis for each month-end close cycle and develop meaningful management reporting schedules for direct areas supported.
Partners with the business leaders and their teams on reporting matters, Master data investigations and support, and month-end close management data issues.
Works directly with Finance Shared Service contacts on monthly close processes to ensure complete, accurate, and timely monthly actual results, including arising issues, journal entry status, and open/pending items. Understand monthly results and communicate issues vs. benchmark to functional partners to drive resolution or action plans.

The role will establish the global HR portfolio across three connected categories: annual strategic priorities, ongoing run-the-business programs and services, and locally managed programs and services across affiliates and regions.
Reporting to the leader of People Strategy & Transformation, this role connects people strategy to execution by building the portfolio, governance, technology, integrated roadmap, and decision forums required to improve prioritization and portfolio value. The portfolio will provide the CHRO and HR Leadership Team (HRLT) with a clear view of commitments, timing, dependencies, capacity, risks, and outcomes, enabling disciplined trade-offs across global and local work.
This role is for a pragmatic portfolio leader who can operate in ambiguity, create clarity across a complex global HR ecosystem, and translate strategy into simple, sustainable processes. Success will be defined not by producing project summaries, but by enabling higher-quality decisions, reducing activation friction, strengthening accountability, and increasing the impact of HR investments on employees and the business.
Key Responsibilities
Global HR Portfolio Strategy & Design
Create and maintain a comprehensive global HR portfolio that provides visibility into strategic initiatives, run-the-business programs and services, and local or regional HR programs and services.
Define a practical portfolio taxonomy, minimum data standards, ownership expectations, and governance model that create a consistent view of HR work across Centers of Excellence (COEs), Business HR (BHR), regions, and affiliates.
Connect the portfolio to the People Strategy & Transformation team's broader mandate for HR strategy, annual prioritization, planning, budgeting, technology strategy, and transformation, ensuring portfolio insights translate into action.
Ensure the portfolio reflects strategic alignment, clear outcomes, realistic delivery commitments, dependencies, resource requirements, risks, and expected employee and business value.
Portfolio Technology & Information Architecture
Lead the evaluation and recommendation of the right technology platform to house the global HR portfolio, in partnership with HR Technology, BTS/IT, and key stakeholders.
Define business and user requirements for a solution that allows program teams to manage detailed project information while enabling leaders to access concise, decision-ready portfolio views.
Establish the information architecture, data standards, reporting requirements, role-based access, and integration needs required for a trusted global source of portfolio information.
Guide implementation and adoption of the selected solution, balancing enterprise visibility with simple, low-burden maintenance for project and program teams.
Integrated Roadmap & Activation Management
Create and maintain an integrated, multi-horizon roadmap as the executive-level output of the global HR portfolio.
Provide the CHRO and HRLT with visibility into major HR activations, business moments, dependencies, decision points, and periods of concentrated change.
Identify friction points created by overlapping HR activations, conflicts with critical business moments, and cumulative demand on employees, managers, and HR teams.
Enable fact-based sequencing and trade-off decisions that account for both HR delivery capacity and the capacity of the business and employees to absorb and metabolize change.
Portfolio Intake, Governance & Maintenance
Design and implement clear portfolio intake processes with central HR teams, including COEs and BHR, and with global, regional, and local HR teams.
Define the minimum project and service information required to support enterprise transparency, prioritization, sequencing, risk management, and decision making.
Establish ownership, validation, update, and escalation processes so portfolio information remains current, complete, and reliable.
Create an operating rhythm for ongoing maintenance, including scheduled data reviews, exception management, quality controls, and accountability for timely updates.
Continuously simplify portfolio processes and standards based on stakeholder feedback, data quality, adoption, and decision usefulness.
Quarterly Business Reviews & Decision Forums
Establish and help manage quarterly portfolio reviews (QBRs) that elevate the conversation from project status reporting to impact, risk, value, capacity, and future decisions.
Design forums, pre-reads, analytics, and decision agendas that enable productive dialogue among central HR teams, global and local HR leaders, and HRLT.
Facilitate alignment on what should be supported globally, what should be managed or driven locally, and where common solutions, sequencing changes, or trade-offs are required.
Surface portfolio-level dependencies, delivery risks, capacity constraints, and decisions requiring HRLT sponsorship or intervention.
Track decisions, owners, and follow-through from QBRs to ensure governance produces measurable action and stronger portfolio outcomes.
Measurement, Value & Portfolio Insights
Partner with People Analytics & Insights to help program teams define meaningful outcome measures, leading indicators, and value-realization metrics for HR programs and services.
Build portfolio views that connect investment, delivery health, adoption, employee or business impact, and strategic contribution.
Increase accountability among program teams and leaders for demonstrating the value of HR investments and using evidence to inform continuation, acceleration, redesign, scaling, or retirement decisions.
Translate portfolio data into concise executive insights, recommendations, and narratives for the CHRO, HRLT, and other senior stakeholders.
Stakeholder Partnership & Capability Building
Build trusted partnerships across COEs, BHR, People Experience, HR Technology, People Analytics & Insights, Finance, BTS/IT, and regional and affiliate HR teams.
Influence senior HR leaders to adopt common portfolio practices, make transparent trade-offs, and use portfolio insights in planning and prioritization decisions.
Coach program owners and teams on portfolio standards, outcome definition, executive storytelling, and preparation for business reviews.
Build a sustainable portfolio-management capability that can scale globally without creating unnecessary administrative burden.
Required
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Project or Portfolio Management, or a related field.
5-10 years of progressive HR experience, including meaningful responsibility for HR strategy, portfolio management, program governance, transformation, HR operations, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience establishing, managing, and using an HR portfolio to support prioritization, sequencing, governance, and leadership decision making.
Experience designing and running business or program reviews focused on outcomes, value, risk, capacity, and forward-looking decisions rather than basic status updates.
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity, structure complex problems, and build clarity and alignment around new enterprise capabilities.
Strong experience influencing senior HR leaders and stakeholders in a complex, matrixed, global organization without relying on direct authority.
Ability to translate strategy into simple processes, governance, decision frameworks, and actionable outcomes.
Experience partnering with analytics teams and program leaders to define metrics for HR programs and services and use evidence to improve accountability and investment decisions.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex portfolio information into decision-ready insights.
Preferred
Advanced degree in business, human resources, organizational development, or a related field.
Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, life sciences, or another highly matrixed and regulated global industry.
Experience selecting, implementing, or administering enterprise portfolio, project, work-management, or strategic-planning technology.

title: LBA Automation Scientist II
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The LBA Operations lab within Quantitative Translational & ADME Sciences (QTAS) in Worcester, MA, is seeking a motivated, independent, and experienced automation Scientist to support pre-clinical bioanalytical programs in a non-regulated and fast-paced environment. This role focuses on 1) the bioanalysis of animal samples dosed with large molecule therapeutics, including pharmacokinetic (PK), toxicokinetic (TK) pharmacodynamic (PD), and anti-drug-antibody (ADA) studies using manual and automated Meso Scale Discovery (MSD) assay protocols; and 2) designing and optimizing new automation protocols for the LBA workflow on Tecan and Hamilton liquid handlers.
The primary responsibilities of the Scientist I/II role include developing and executing bioanalytical strategies to support PK, PD, TK, and ADA studies via LBA using automated liquid handling systems. This lab-based role focuses on bioanalytical assay design, planning, data interpretation, and application of automation knowledge to increase analytical capabilities in support of oncology, immunology, and neuroscience portfolios.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in bioanalysis, biochemistry, chemistry, or related fields along with bioanalytical assay automation. The candidate is expected to execute bioanalytical assay design and data interpretation, while driving automation strategies for pre-clinical sample analysis.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Design and execute pre-clinical (rodent, NHP) bioanalytical studies using newly developed or existing bioanalytical protocols using manual and automated LBA protocols (Hamilton and Tecan instruments).
Serve as an automation SME for the lab and set up automated assay strategies for large molecule bioanalysis.
Effectively and clearly communicate assay plans, timelines, results, and data interpretations with study teams and QTAS stakeholders.
Train and mentor junior scientists on LBA protocols using automation.
Archive data in ELN and LIMS systems.
Write and update experimental protocols and procedures.
Initiate, design, interpret, and troubleshoot operational assays independently and efficiently.
Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, or pharmacology with 7+ years industry experience or MS or equivalent with 5+ years of experience.
Previous experience conducting PK/PD/TK bioanalysis on antibodies, bi/multi-specifics and/or ADCs, including data interpretation is required.
Highly motivated, reliable, and independent contributor with attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Experience with assay development and troubleshooting using ligand binding workflows (ELISA, MSD) is a must. Automation experience is required.
Team player. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with computers and data analysis software, including LIMS systems.
Ability to design, summarize, communicate, and interpret bioanalytical results.
Creative leader and problem solver who collaborates effectively in a highly matrixed environment.  This position is onsite and located at the AbbVie Bioresearch Center in Worcester, MA.

description:

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Medical Affairs (MA) organization provides patients, healthcare providers and payers everywhere with the practical and clinically relevant information and solutions they need to use AbbVie products safely and effectively, throughout the product lifecycle and the patient’s journey.
Scientific Director provides medical and scientific input into strategic and operational medical affairs activities for AbbVie’s Neuroscience portfolio such as: health care professional and provider interactions (Payers, Patients, Prescribers, and Providers); generation of clinical and scientific data (enhancing therapeutic benefit and value); educational initiatives (medical education, data, guidelines, and value proposition); safeguarding patient safety (risk minimization activities and safety surveillance activities).

Responsible to manage budget for assigned projects.
May support cross-functional teams with subject matter expertise.

title: Scientist I
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Seeking talented and passionate individuals to join our growing team, working together to advance cutting-edge scientific research, experiments and analytics. This role is based at AbbVie Waltham’s new, state-of-the-art laboratory designed to enable next-generation innovation.
We are looking for a technical expert that will support late-stage process development activities of conjugated drug products. Ideally someone who can do the following:
Independently execute laboratory experiments to address critical project needs, and identify opportunities for development and improvement in collaboration with supervisor.
Continuously seek to improve existing laboratory methods and processes.
Demonstrate mastery of experimental techniques and methods of data analysis used in day-to-day responsibilities.
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional groups to support project goals
Responsibilities:
Independently execute, and interpret critical experiments to answer scientific questions related to pharmaceutical development activities. Understand the broad objectives of the project as well as their role in achieving those objectives, and modify experimental plan when required.
Meet experimental and project timelines in accordance with CMC strategy.
Work collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary team, including analytical chemists, process chemists, and manufacturing personnel.
Support development projects with hands-on laboratory experimentation, data generation, and analysis of results. As needed, provide support for technical transfer and scale-up of laboratory process knowledge to manufacturing sites.
Learn and understand new experimental techniques, and develop proficiency in techniques to serve as a resource for others.
Maintain detailed and organized electronic laboratory notebook, and compile data into scientific presentations and reports to support project goals.
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education with typically 5 years of experience, or Master’s Degree or equivalent education with typically two years of experience.
Theoretical and practical knowledge to carry out the job functions.

The Molecular Profiling and Drug Delivery (MPDD) function within the Small Molecule CMC organization is accountable for a broad range of deliverables across various stages of drug discovery and development. During lead optimization and through candidate selection, MPDD scientists utilize state-of-the-art automation and computational tools supported by expertise in biopharmaceutics, drug delivery, and solid-state chemistry to collaboratively progress candidates with higher probability of success into development and advise clinical formulation strategy. From candidate selection through clinical proof of concept and product launch, MPDD scientists work in cross functional teams to identify the commercial solid form of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and establish structure-property-performance correlations to help deliver robust commercial processes and align control strategies across drug substance and product. They also transition drug substance isolation processes and relevant physical characterization methods to commercial manufacturing sites and work within teams to ensure successful regulatory submissions.
Biopharmaceutics and Drug Delivery scientists within AbbVie's MPDD organization work collaboratively with other functions within Development Sciences and Discovery to conduct developability assessment to select molecules with higher probability of success for clinical development and eventual commercialization. This includes profiling of physicochemical properties, development of preclinical formulations, identifying solutions to in vivo absorption challenges, and advancement of novel drug delivery strategies across multiple routes of administration that are aligned with program target product profiles and downstream partners.  Modalities of interest include traditional small molecules as well as complex chemically synthesized modalities such as protein degraders and peptides.  In this role, you will work in cross-functional teams in matrixed environments and engage in multidisciplinary problem solving.

AbbVie's MPDD organization is seeking a highly motivated scientist with experience in biopharmaceutics for a Scientist I position. The primary role of this position is to design, execute, analyze, and interpret the studies that characterize the biopharmaceutical properties of drug candidates and enable developability and product performance related informed decision-making for emerging molecules on peptide and small molecule pipeline programs. The successful candidate will apply scientific knowledge and laboratory skills to support early- and late-stage development activities, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary partners. Targeted lipid nanoparticles (tLNPs) represent a key new modality to enable effective delivery of mRNA. The tLNP chemistry, manufacturing, and control (CMC) team (TCT) is a newly formed group under Biologics CMC, Development Sciences, R&D. TCT focuses on process development for tLNPs, including mRNA process development, tLNP process development, and formulation development.
The tLNP Process Development team is seeking a highly motivated, talented, and innovative scientist with expertise in mRNA-LNP process development and an interest in laboratory automation. This team is responsible for the end-to-end manufacturing process from purified mRNA to purified tLNP bulk drug product, including encapsulating mRNA with lipid components to form LNPs, conjugating LNPs with a targeting moiety, and purifying the final tLNPs via tangential flow filtration (TFF).
The successful candidate will help advance fundamental understanding of tLNP unit operations, such as mRNA encapsulation, bioconjugation, and TFF, as well as scaling up lab processes into pre-clinical, clinical, and commercial scale manufacturing processes. The candidate will also apply automation expertise to integrate off-the-shelf and custom-built hardware, software, and data workflows into flexible experimental platforms that increase throughput, reproducibility, and process understanding.
The end goal for tLNP Process Development team is to deliver a robust manufacturing process at commercial scale. This includes science-based, hands-on approaches in the lab to optimize process parameters and understand the impact of process parameters on critical quality attributes. First-principle-based and statistical modeling will be applied where appropriate. Along the pharmaceutical development life cycle, the team will be responsible for successful production of non-GMP pre-clinical safety study supplies and GMP clinical study supplies from a manufacturing plant on site or at third party manufacturers. The team will also lead the tech transfer of commercial processes into a commercial facility. Additionally, the team reviews appropriate sections of Common Technical Document (CTD) for regulatory submissions.
Success in this role depends on close collaboration with the mRNA process development, drug product development, and analytical development, digital and automation partners, as well as cross-functional partners across Biologics CMC and Synthetic Molecule CMC. This role is for an enterprise-scale strategist and systems thinker who understands how to connect vision to execution, drive structural and cultural change across a complex global organization, and leverage technology and storytelling to reimagine how HR delivers value. This role will lead a team of highly specialized functions and will serve as a driving force behind AbbVie's next generation of HR transformation.
Key Responsibilities

Define and champion an enterprise-wide people strategy that aligns with AbbVie's business priorities, workforce needs, and the long-term vision of the People Experience team.
Translate complex workforce trends, competitive intelligence, and organizational data into clear strategic direction for the PE organization, while supporting socialization with HR’s senior stakeholders.
Partner with the VP of People Experience and PE Leadership Team to set the multi-year strategic agenda and ensure coherent prioritization across functions.
Serve as a forward-looking thought leader, anticipating shifts in the external talent and HR landscape and positioning AbbVie to stay ahead.
People Branding & Storytelling
Lead AbbVie's People Branding strategy, shaping how the company's employee value proposition (EVP) and talent brand are articulated, activated, and experienced globally.
Build a compelling storytelling capability within the PE organization — translating the impact of People programs and initiatives into narratives that resonate with employees, candidates, leaders, and external stakeholders.
Partner with Corporate Communications, Marketing, and Business HR to ensure consistency and authenticity of AbbVie's people brand across all touchpoints.
Champion the PE team's own brand and visibility — elevating the strategic contribution of the People Experience function across the enterprise.
HR Strategy & Annual Prioritization
Own the HR strategy planning cycle, leading the annual prioritization process that aligns PE investments, resources, and initiatives to AbbVie's enterprise and business unit priorities.
Develop and maintain a clear, accessible view of the HR strategic agenda — ensuring all PE functions operate with shared context and coordinated direction.
Drive disciplined tradeoff decisions and resource allocation, ensuring the PE team is focused on highest-value work and prepared to adapt as business conditions evolve.
Establish and track strategic KPIs that measure progress toward the PE vision and demonstrate HR's impact on the business.

description:

Conceive and implement novel experimental approaches to address key scientific questions in immune cell depletion. Contribute scientific insights to projects, particularly in areas such as inflammatory pathways, immune cell trafficking, immune receptor modulation, receptor targeting, target density in tissues, and receptor occupancy. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including in vivo pharmacology, DMPK, and technology groups, to drive technical problem-solving and integrate efforts across projects. We are looking for a Senior Scientist I with a strong background in immunology, cell biology, and therapeutic discovery to join AbbVie’s Immunology Discovery organization. This lab-based position supports IND-enabling and early-stage discovery programs, as well as research and innovation in selective pathogenic cell depletion. The role involves hands-on experimentation using translational in vitro and ex vivo assays and PK/PD assessments, including autoimmune disease efficacy models, to evaluate depletion strategies and therapeutic candidates.

​​• Innovative Research & Method Development: Consistently demonstrate scientific initiative and creativity by exploring novel experimental approaches and developing new immunological methods to address complex research questions.

​• Scientific Communication: Prepare clear and detailed technical reports and documentation of results, and effectively communicate findings through presentations and peer-reviewed publications, upholding AbbVie’s standards of scientific excellence.

​• Bioinformatics and computational biology: Experience applying bioinformatics and computational biology approaches to analyze high-dimensional immunology datasets, including single-cell RNA sequencing, bulk transcriptomics, immune-receptor repertoire data, or multi-omics, and translating results into testable biological hypotheses and drug discovery decisions.

We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
This role is field-based, and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city.
Talent will be hired at a level commensurate with experience.
This geography covers the areas surrounding: All of Minnesota (minus Rochester area) and all of North Dakota. Ideally looking for a candidate in the Minneapolis Metro area.
Execute brand strategy and tactics in field, sales performance, effectively manage assigned territory and targeted accounts, build strong customer relationships and customer needs solving capability to maximize short and long term sales performance placing the patient into the center of any efforts and operating within AbbVie’s business code of conduct, policies and all applicable laws and regulations.
Responsibilities:
Deliver sales performance, brand KPIs, financial targets, marketing objectives, etc. in order to meet or exceed on those objectives.
Create pre-call plan using SMART objectives and execute post-call evaluation in order to continuously improve sales performance. Effectively handle objections, misunderstandings, concerns and consistently gain logical and reasonable calls to action in order to close on every sales call.
Proactively and continuously aspire to serve customer needs, customer expectations and challenges in order to build trusted customer relationships and to achieve win-win agreements between AbbVie and customers.
Develop and execute a call plan that achieves set call metrics and optimizes coverage and frequency to key customers in order to maximize access and sales opportunities.
Continuously build understanding on customer needs and expectations, territory market landscape, competitors, market segments/dynamics, accounts, disease, product, clinical and sales expertise and share this market intelligence information with in-field team, brand team and sales manager to achieve alignment, to anticipate environmental changes and challenges and to optimize brand strategy and its execution.
Differentiate AbbVie’s value proposition with health providers assigned and identify, develop and maintain disease state experts and speakers/advocates in order to maximize brand performance.
Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required
Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of experience with three (3) or more years of experience within the pharmaceutical/health/science industry preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
Proven track record of success in selling and solid presentation skills. Proactively identifies customer style / behavior and adapts quickly all aspects of selling approach. Offers innovative ideas and solutions to maximize business opportunities to address challenges. Provides impact with ideas for the larger organization and anticipates and responds to changes.
Influences others & is viewed as a credible and respected role model and resource among peers. Builds collaborative partnership with district colleagues and matrix team, etc. Leads by example; consistently displays positive behaviors and peer coaching through changing and challenging environments.
Documented success in leadership and support role of increased responsibility at the district, region and/or organizational levels. Understands and leverages findings to develop sales strategies.
Preferred: Proven track record of success in sales performance within respective therapeutic areas. Commercial pharmaceutical industry experiences such as physician/account based selling, training, managed health care or marketing preferred. English language proficiency verbally and in writing (for all non-English speaking countries).
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.
Demonstrates in-depth scientific, therapeutic, product, and competitive knowledge and is recognized as an expert resource by all relevant stakeholders. Strong business acumen and proficient use of business tools; possesses strategic and critical thinking capabilities. Operates effectively in a matrix environment.
Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements.

External: Specialty Physicians in Therapeutic brand area, pharmacists, nurses, others depending on brand plan.
Internal: In-field team members, Sales Management (i.e. DSM), Marketing Management, Training, Customer Excellence, & Brand Plan stakeholders

title: Sr Manager, Strategic Process Excellence Lead - OED Development Operations
description:
About AbbVie

Purpose:
The Sr Manager Process Excellence Lead (PEL) is accountable for continually optimizing Oncology Early Development business processes (including clinical operations, data management, statistical programming and medical monitoring), that will identify and define process improvement opportunities and assure accurate process documentation, appropriate training and delivery mechanisms, content creation, compliance, and system implementation.
The Sr Manager PEL will identify, plan, and execute opportunities to drive innovative process excellence and deliver on organizational strategies, goals, and objectives. They will act as primary point of contact for continuous process improvement and change management activities for OED and communicate key information and updates to appropriate leadership, function heads and senior leadership for alignment and endorsement.
Responsibilities:
Serves as an Oncology Early Development (OED) Development Operations’ process expert, knowledge leader and owner of process health. Is accountable for process performance oversight, process related decision-making, and all process related maintenance activities. Additionally, partners closely with functional area management and experts to streamline and optimize process content, outputs, and quality.
Proactively defines metrics and KPIs for assigned process areas with a goal of measuring process health and compliance.  Strategically forecasts and manages plans/updates for assigned processes in collaboration with leaders and function heads, and others as needed, utilizing knowledge of current and future business environment.
Responds to process-related questions, alerts team and leadership of trends, proactively identifies knowledge gaps and prepares plans for remediation.
Leads and delivers continuous process improvement for assigned business process area(s) by strategically identifying pain points and opportunities for efficiency.
Lead and / or participates in working teams to defines processes drive implementation including updates to global operating procedures, functional requirement specifications, training materials and process design documentation as needed.
Own the governance and maintenance of OED operating models, process frameworks, and knowledge resources, serving as the primary resource for operational guidance and interpretation of established processes, standards, and ways of working.
Monitors and analyzes operational performance and compliance metrics and KPIs to demonstrate process effectiveness and quality, identify areas of improvement and recommend solutions.  Participates in process aligned initiatives to drive transformational improvements and makes strategic, aligned decisions via relationships with cross-functional stakeholders. Leverages process improvement tools to identify and implement countermeasures to improve efficiency, quality, and compliance.
Displays original thinking and creativity, meets challenges with resourcefulness, generates suggestions for improving work, and effectively presents ideas and information.
Ensures sustainability of all improvements post-implementation by partnering with cross-functional team leaders and process owners to define the optimal performance measurements to track and measure success over time.
Upholds organizational values and demonstrates sound business ethics, works with integrity and ethics in all situations, and always treats others with respect and consideration.  Takes responsibility for actions, reacts well under pressure, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates consistency between words and actions.
Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years in Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, or regulated industry; 6+ with Masters, 4+ with PhD (required).
5+ years process management and continuous improvement experience preferred.
Strong project management skills with the ability to be resourceful and adapt to situations with unknowns, but still be able to drive progress while communicating and delivering presentations with impact, experience in the process area of responsibility (preferred).
Experience with use and/or development of metrics to drive risk-based business decisions and/or improvements including working with data sets to draw out conclusions and business insights.  Strong business insight and ability to assess trends, complex data sets, generate robust business cases and impact analysis.
Recognized leader and expert in standard business procedures, including project and change management practices, with robust understanding of GxP.
Strong organizational, team building, and communication skills. The ability to work and navigate within a complex matrixed organization with a track record of delivering impactful, transformative change (required).
Demonstration of successful stakeholder management through communication and leadership with broad business orientation.
Solid interpersonal and influencing skills to ensure buy in at various levels and within and across various functions of the organization who can collaborate to drive better outcomes.
Comfortable with out of the box thinking and challenging status quo.
Understanding of efficiency principles such as Lean/Six Sigma; Black belt, Business Process Management Professional (BPMP) Certificate and/or similar recognized industry continuous improvement programs preferred.

description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) is responsible for representing the SkinMedica, DiamondGlow and Latisse brands and promote the product portfolio to targeted aesthetic customers within a designated geographical area. The focus will be on direct selling of products (physician dispensed skincare and skin resurfacing system) and executing pull through programs/events to patients. This is accomplished by utilizing and managing key resources and contributing with high performance selling teams to maximize coverage to targeted customers. The SAM provides technical product and procedure expertise, as well as, competitive product differentiation. Assigned sales goals are obtained through creative, consultative selling and implementation of the U.S. Sales/Marketing plan.
​​The SAM leverages Allergan Medical’s resources to enhance adoption of the SKM Portfolio which includes
1) non-surgical, non-invasive skin resurfacing equipment,
2) topical skincare consumables designed for the resurfacing device and
3) SkinMedica product portfolio. Must collaborate with Facial Aesthetics, Plastic Surgery, Coolsculpting, APC’s, Marketing, and other Allergan sales forces. Complies with required reports, requests, and compliance policies.
•Effectively manages field assets and resources to include, but not limited to, expense management, computer, and other allocated equipment.
•SALES RESULTS: Consistently achieves sales quota for skin care, consumables, and equipment. Proficient in sales execution component of marketing plans to include device placement and pull through product promotions (device, consumables and SkinMedica portfolio). Creates call plans across product portfolio. Demonstrates adaptability with multiple initiatives.
•Demonstrates effective selling skills (demonstrate Dermalinfusion Treatments, educate customers on proper techniques for Dermalinfusion Treatments, consultative sales approach to the customers' business, pre-call plans, Intro/credentialing, assessment of customer needs, handling objections, presentation delivery with visuals, closing, follow-up, etc.). Builds loyal relationships; high level customer interaction.

title: Strategic Site Partner
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
PURPOSE
The success of CDO depends on our ability to develop a holistic strategy and global network of exceptional PIs and institutions in order to accelerate delivery of our pipeline.  In an increasingly competitive landscape, strategic partnerships are critical to maximizing the solid tumor and hematology pipelines.  The Strategic Site Partner (SSP) serves as a key driver and main point of contact for our key partner sites and is passionate about establishing and strengthening strategic partnerships cross-functionally with key clinical sites in order to unlock operational potential and build strong, longitudinal relationships.
The SSP is responsible for adopting relationship management principles and critically thinking to better understand all business dimensions to impact and drive operational efficiencies in the conduct of AbbVie’s pipeline. In addition, they will align expectations between AbbVie and investigative site stakeholders proactively identifying opportunities to drive clinical trial accelerations and efficiencies at the study and/or program level.
The SSP is responsible for engaging internal leaders at all levels to maximally leverage aligned collaborations cross functionally with a goal of enabling alliances to deliver results consistent with strategic goals and to enhance AbbVie’s relationships to secure the company's reputation as a Partner of Choice.
The Strategic Site Partner reports to the Director, Strategic Site Partnership .
Responsibilities :
Provides input and develop the site-specific engagement strategy for assigned sites.
Builds and manages relationships with assigned investigative sites through a white-glove service. approach while meeting with Institution Leadership, Principal Investigator and clinical site staff both on-site and remotely.
Raises the bar to proactively anticipate a site’s needs and drives timely mitigation strategies.
Maintains a solution-oriented mindset to facilitate resolution of complex operational issues.
Remains informed of best practices and innovations that have resulted in efficiencies across the business and/or industry and put actions in place that support the organization in removing identified barriers.
Identifies areas to drive efficiencies and/or accelerate clinical trial execution. Drives consistency across studies and programs.
Oversees overall performance metrics across studies, conducts review of site’s operations for quality. Evaluates and addresses aligned KPIs with site.
Reviews and shares upcoming study forecasts and current clinical study needs regarding the studies in which the site is participating for strategic resource planning with the site.
Reviews interests and study capacity with site and communicates back to internal AbbVie stakeholders.
Identifies and recommends opportunities for internal improvements, implements improvements to maximize process efficiency/accelerate trial delivery at the site.
Reviews cross business portfolio forecasts of studies to provide direction for investigative sites.
Escalates risk to relevant stakeholders, resolves identified operational issues that span across studies/programs.
Seeks to align AbbVie and the site's operations to execute clinical trials efficiently.
Provides operational and holistic focus on site needs to ensure optimal delivery of clinical trials.
Generates, expands and enhances operational effectiveness and consistency within AbbVie and at the investigative sites.
Works closely with internal stakeholders to facilitate, manage and oversee the scientific and operational relationships cross functionally across AbbVie to ensure a productive working environment.
Provides cross-functional partners an open and continuous channel of communication to ensure investigative sites perspectives are heard and well represented internally.
Bachelors or higher degree required, degree in health care or scientific field preferred.
Minimum of 10 years applicable work experience in clinical research demonstrating a high level of core, technical, and leadership competencies through driving strategy. Prior relationship management experience preferred.
Broad understanding of global pharmaceutical and biotech industries with a solid understanding of drug discovery and development processes. Expertise in drug development, operations, strategic and tactical planning,
Strong communication skills with advanced interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate persuasively with clarity, collaboratively, and cross functionally.
Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills; ability to establish good working relationships with external and internal stakeholders as well as management.
Seamless collaborator with demonstrated ability to influence without authority – easily builds relationships across locations and gains cross-functional alignment.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to evaluate complex issues from multiple perspectives and drive smart decision making.
Demonstrated leadership, influence skills, creativity, problem solving and ability to manage complexity in addressing issues.
Demonstration of success in a fast‐paced environment managing multiple priorities, comfortable to manage risk and ambiguity, changing course when needed.
Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills.
Ability to travel up approximately 10%-20% of the time for on-site partner engagements.  Additional travel may be required.
