description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose
The TA Systems & Operations Specialist supports the execution, optimization, and continuous improvement of Talent Acquisition technology, workflows, automation, operational reporting, and service delivery.
This role partners with Talent Acquisition Operations, HRIT, Process Optimization, and other cross-functional teams to translate business needs into functional requirements, coordinate system enhancements, and identify opportunities to improve operational effectiveness.
A significant component of the position involves independently analyzing operational data, identifying trends and potential root causes, and translating findings into actionable insights and recommendations for Talent Acquisition and Operations & Innovation stakeholders.
The role combines analytical capability, systems knowledge, problem-solving, and strong communication skills to support data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
Responsibilities
1. TA Systems Execution & Enhancements | 25%
Coordinate and support enhancements across Talent Acquisition technology platforms, including ServiceNow HRSD, SmartRecruiters, Workday, and related applications.
Gather, document, and translate business needs into functional requirements and user stories for HRIT and technology partners.
Maintain system enhancement requests and support backlog prioritization in partnership with TA Operations leadership.
Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), defect tracking, implementation readiness, and post-launch validation.
Identify opportunities to improve system functionality, user experience, workflow efficiency, and data accuracy.
Support system integrations by documenting business requirements, investigating operational issues, and coordinating resolution with technical teams.
2. Operational Reporting, Analytics & Business Insights | 30%
Develop, generate, and maintain recurring and ad hoc operational reports using ServiceNow, Excel, and other available reporting tools.
Analyze ticket volumes, service-level performance, resolution trends, workflow effectiveness, system adoption, and operational performance.
Investigate recurring issues, process inefficiencies, and emerging trends to identify potential root causes.
Translate complex data into actionable business insights, identifying operational risks, improvement opportunities, and recommended actions.
Develop dashboards, visualizations, and executive-ready presentations that communicate performance results and their operational implications.
Summarize and present findings and recommendations to TA Operations, Operations & Innovation, and broader Talent Acquisition stakeholders.
Partner with Process Optimization and operational teams to evaluate improvement opportunities and measure outcomes.
Support workload forecasting, capacity analysis, and identification of emerging service-delivery trends.
3. Workflow Optimization & Automation | 20%
Analyze existing Talent Acquisition workflows to identify manual activities, repetitive transactions, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities.
Review operational trends to identify opportunities for workflow redesign, self-service, automation, and process simplification.
Document current-state and future-state workflows, business rules, decision points, and functional requirements.
Partner with HRIT and Process Optimization to support automation design, implementation, testing, and validation.
Maintain a pipeline of identified workflow improvement and automation opportunities and provide recommendations on potential priorities.
Track and report the operational impact of implemented enhancements, including efficiency gains, reduced manual effort, and improved user experience.
4. Knowledge Management & AI Enablement | 15%
Support the ongoing maintenance, organization, and optimization of the ServiceNow knowledge management environment.
Maintain knowledge content standards, article metadata, categorization, and documentation accuracy.
Analyze operational trends and recurring inquiries to identify knowledge gaps and opportunities to strengthen self-service capabilities.
Partner with subject matter experts to develop and update standard operating procedures, system documentation, and knowledge articles.
Support AI-enabled service-delivery initiatives, including Now Assist and virtual assistant capabilities, through knowledge optimization and identification of potential use cases.
Monitor knowledge effectiveness, adoption, and recurring support needs and recommend improvements to support operational efficiency and self-service.
5. Systems Standards, Controls & Cross-Functional Collaboration | 10%
Support the standardization of Talent Acquisition system workflows, documentation, business rules, and operational controls.
Coordinate with HRIT, HR Operations, TA leadership, and technology partners to support consistent system execution.
Maintain system process documentation, workflow inventories, enhancement records, and change logs.
Identify system-related risks, control gaps, and process inconsistencies and escalate issues or recommend corrective actions as appropriate.
Support technology releases, change readiness, stakeholder communications, and adoption activities.
Provide operational insights and recommendations to support TA technology planning and continuous-improvement priorities.
Required
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
3+ years of experience in business operations, systems analysis, reporting and analytics, HR technology, process improvement, or related functions.
Experience generating reports, analyzing operational data, identifying trends, and developing business-focused recommendations.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation, and trend analysis.
Experience working with enterprise systems, workflow platforms, or service-management technologies.
Experience documenting business requirements, workflows, and process improvements.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint with the ability to develop clear, compelling presentations for business stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data findings and technical concepts to nontechnical audiences.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and assigned deliverables while collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

Experience with ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD), including reporting, workflows, knowledge management, or enhancement coordination.

title: 2027 Intern - AI & Architecture
description:
The Opportunity
The Adobe Data Science team is looking for a summer intern! The team applies AI and machine learning techniques to big customer data to address and challenge business problems, such as driving go-to-market strategies, sales prioritization, increasing product engagement and customer service improvement.
All 2026 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.
What You’ll Do
Turn business needs into architecture options. Work with architects and business partners to understand requirements. Then help write up solution options that weigh architecture standards, readiness, implementation effort and total cost of ownership.
Build AI tools for architecture work. Prototype AI assistants or agents that help with architecture reviews, risk analysis and documentation, such as summarizing designs, checking them against standards and flagging gaps early.
Make architecture guidance easier to use. Apply AI to our standards, reference patterns and architecture repositories (for example, LeanIX) so teams can find and use the guidance on their own.
Work across business domains. Partner with Adobe architects across Marketing, Sales, Post-Sales and Finance to design solutions that help customers get started, renew and get more value from Adobe.
Evaluate new technology. Research and test new AI and platform technologies, such as agent frameworks, MCP integration and AI observability tools. Share recommendations that feed into the Enterprise Architecture roadmap.
Share what you learn. Present your prototypes, findings and recommendations to architects and leaders at the end of your internship.

Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a Bachelor's or Master’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineer, or equivalent experience required
Self-motivation
Strong technical background with analytical and problem-solving skills
Eagerness to research and learn new technologies
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

description:

What does it take for the people who sell to and host Adobe's customers to do their best work? Which tools, technology, and spaces help them build strong customer relationships, and which ones slow them down? As an Experience Research Intern on the Workplace Digital Experiences team, you'll help us find out!
Our team designs and runs the technology behind how Adobe works together, from meeting spaces and customer briefing centers to Lab82, our workplace experimentation program. This summer, you'll lead a UX research project with Adobe's sales and customer-facing teams around the world, including our international markets, and turn what you learn into clear personas and needs. Partner with our data analyst to compare what people tell you with usage and service data.
Build journey maps and personas, then turn them into a ranked list of opportunities, including concepts to test in Lab82.
Use Qualtrics, Miro, AI tools, and Adobe products to plan, analyze, and share your research.

Familiarity with survey design and basic quantitative analysis.

Curiosity and comfort working through open-ended problems with people across teams.
Interest in using AI tools to plan, analyze, and share research.

title: Director of Engineering, Real Time Experience (RTX)
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe's Digital Video & Audio (DVA) business builds Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Media Encoder, the tools that filmmakers, broadcasters, and creators trust to tell their stories. At the center of these products sits the Realtime Experience (RTX) team. RTX owns the rendering engine, GPU abstraction layer, compositor, video player, importer and exporter host, and Effects and Transitions SDK. Every frame our customers play, edit, and export passes through this stack.
The next 12 months will define the future of video creation at Adobe. RTX is finishing its GPU-first pipeline, moving to a modern graphics API, and designing how AI-native rendering fits in. Leader for this team will shape the engine under Premiere Pro and After Effects for years to come.
We are hiring a Director of Engineering for RTX. The team is senior and highly specialized, and it needs a leader with matching depth. The Director will own these modernization efforts and align the many teams that touch rendering, as Topaz and LTX integrations arrive.
What You Will Do
This role sets the technical vision for the rendering technology behind DVA's desktop products, with a near-term focus on Premiere Pro performance and stability. Architectural decisions come with clear investment plans for engineering and quality engineering.
Deliver the GPU-first rendering pipeline to improve playback, scrubbing, and dropped frames.
Choose and lead the move to a modern graphics and compute API such as DirectX 12, Vulkan, or Dawn/WebGPU.
Define how AI features and partner technologies such as Topaz and LTX fit the render pipeline while keeping quality and user experience high.
Unify rendering, effects, and transitions across desktop, web, and mobile.
Build lasting partnerships with technology leaders and shape our roadmap around their platform plans.
Work with media and format teams to modernize legacy components, and align partner teams on shared priorities.
Lead the engineering side of a Developer Relations effort to unify and document our SDKs and raise third-party plugin quality, protecting a key competitive advantage.
The Director also grows a team of managers, architects, and senior engineers, protects the quality bar, and coaches leaders as the organization changes.
What We Are Looking For (Must Have)
Are you a technical leader whose judgment shapes the product? The ideal candidate does not need to write shaders, but knows which paths lead to great outcomes and can defend that view to engineers, partners, and executives.
12+ years of software engineering experience, with deep architectural judgment in GPU-accelerated, real-time rendering, graphics, or media systems.
5+ years leading engineering teams, with proven people leadership at senior engineering manager level or above, including developing managers and growing careers.
Experience building or leading performance-critical software such as rendering engines, playback and compositing systems, game engines, or broadcast tools.
Strong knowledge of GPU architecture and compute, and of modern graphics APIs including Metal, DirectX 12, Vulkan, and WebGPU.
A track record in large, mature C/C++ desktop codebases, modernizing them while continuing to ship.
A clear point of view on where rendering technology is heading, and the skill to turn it into a funded, staffed plan.
Strong influence across Product, Engineering, QE, and external partners.
Nice to Have
Understanding of video codecs, formats, and import and export pipelines, and how they affect playback and effects.
Experience in games, VFX, AR/VR, real-time 3D, or live broadcast production.
Experience adding AI or ML inference to rendering or media pipelines.
Experience unifying rendering across desktop, web, and mobile.
Experience building developer ecosystems, SDKs, or plugin programs.

title: Lead Business Process Improvement
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
The Business Process Improvement team focuses on improving processes across all Community Support. Our team is a global team of process improvement professionals, who help bring cross functional partners from across CS and Airbnb together to operationalize new processes, analyze current process for improvement opportunities, and scale solutions across a global network. We follow general business process engineering principles and practices, as well as leveraging Lean Six Sigma methodologies in our improvement projects.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Business Process Improvement (BPI) Lead you are responsible for driving large-scale, cross-functional improvement projects that help to improve customer support for our community.
You will deliver new process designs and process improvements for key priority Community Support (CS) Roadmap programs, where you will take on responsibilities for process analysis, process design, pilot design and execution, and control plan development to improve the user experience.
You will work cross-functionally with other Shared Services functions, Policy, and Product  teams to lead the process impact assessment and subsequent process design for high priority changes. You will drive continuous improvement with these cross functional partners to increase overall operational efficiency, customer experience, and process quality.
You will use and improve AI tools in order to design and implement process measurement systems, analyze process data and utilize this information to drive decision making, successful improvement projects to completion, and propose Continuous Improvement projects. You will create queries and utilize data analytics tools to support process improvement efforts. You will validate analytics with your data partners.
You will be responsible for the delivery of successful improvement projects with measurable positive impact and also transition these solutions to operations for sustained results including feature launches throughout the year.
A Typical Day:
Leads large cross-functional process engineering initiatives from problem definition through measurable outcomes, applying the full suite of Lean Six Sigma tools and a structured process engineering framework across four disciplines: understanding the problem and its system context, designing reliable and measurable solutions, grounding those solutions in operational reality, and evolving them as conditions change.
Apply systems thinking: mapping full upstream and downstream context before prescribing solutions, identifying where the real problem lives rather than where it surfaces.
Design processes for AI-readiness and automation, including designing around three standards: reduce agent and customer burden, measurable from day one, and ability to be automated or self-correcting over time.
Build some AI prototypes to communicate and validate process designs, using AI tools, workflow automation platforms, and lightweight modeling approaches to test the viability of new process architectures before committing to full implementation.
Use some basic process simulation to model how a designed process will behave under real-world conditions, stress-testing assumptions about volume, variation, and failure modes before a design is deployed.
Continuously improve process designs of Community Support experiences that document the full interaction across the customer journey, agent processes, product features, and policies, informing multi-year roadmap planning.
Implement process measurement systems from the start of every design: establish KPIs, deploy statistical process control methods, and track outcomes post-launch to confirm improvements hold.
Lead change management for process transitions, ensuring new designs are adopted effectively by agents, teams, and partners and that improvements are sustained over time.
Partner with Product and Technology teams to translate process requirements into tooling specifications, ensuring AI and other product capabilities are engineered around how agents and customers actually work.
Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Analytics, and Operations to align priorities and drive trade-off decisions grounded in data.
Communicate progress and findings to leadership, distilling complex analysis into clear narratives with a line of sight to measurable outcomes
Organizes their work, keeps project stakeholders updated, and is able to work autonomously to drive progress across stakeholders.

Preferred Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of post-graduate experience in operations (industrial engineering or similar preferred experience)
Advanced knowledge of customer service and contact center operations
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certified or equivalent process engineering expertise. Additional consideration given to Agile, service design, and Industrial and Systems Engineering experience.
Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve quality and efficiency within internal workflows.
Demonstrated ability to design processes for AI-readiness and automation.
Proven experience applying systems thinking to process design, identifying root causes upstream and tracing impacts downstream before prescribing solutions.
Ability to navigate ambiguity with creative problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and a pragmatic sense of how to get things done.
Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with minimal direction.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Materials Program Manager, KGS
description:
Amazon Leo for Government (ALG) is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Operational Program Manager to lead the integration, execution, and delivery of U.S. Government and Department of Defense (DoD) procurement programs for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, ground gateways, and ALG uniquely developed products. This role sits at the critical intersection of government sales requirements, supply chain procurement, contract execution, and invoicing ensuring that complex federal acquisition programs move forward with regulatory compliance, operational precision, and accountability.
In this role, you will serve as the central point of coordination between ALG government sales teams (Leo for Government), engineering, supply chain and procurement operations, contracts and compliance, mission assurance, and finance translating unique U.S. Government and DoD satellite communication requirements into executable procurement orders, compliant contract actions, and accurate invoicing workflows. You will be responsible for the detailed analysis and execution of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) requirements, including supply chain risk management provisions under DFARS Part 252.
The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, possesses deep knowledge of federal procurement regulations, and has a proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders — from engineering and sourcing teams to government contracting officers — without direct authority. You will own the end-to-end operational program lifecycle for government procurement actions, from requirements integration through contract execution, order fulfillment, and financial close-out.
Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Requirements Integration & Program Strategy
• Integrate and translate requirements from Leo for Government sales teams into actionable procurement plans, ensuring alignment with U.S. Government and DoD contract terms, specifications, and delivery schedules
• Conduct detailed analysis of FAR and DFARS requirements applicable to each procurement action, including but not limited to DFARS Part 252 clauses related to supply chain risk management, cybersecurity (CMMC), counterfeit parts prevention, and Trade Agreements Act (TAA) compliance
• Define program vision, scope, objectives, success criteria, and key milestones for government procurement programs in partnership with ALG leadership, contracts & compliance, and mission assurance teams
• Develop comprehensive procurement execution plans including timelines, resource requirements, supplier dependencies, regulatory compliance checkpoints, and risk assessments
• Translate government contract requirements (e.g., CDRLs, SOWs, CLINs) into internal procurement roadmaps with clear ownership and accountability
Procurement Execution & Order Management
• Drive day-to-day execution of procurement orders for LEO satellite systems, sub-systems, ground gateway components, customer terminals, and ALG uniquely developed products
• Coordinate with sourcing leads, engineers, supply chain operations, and third-party suppliers to ensure timely and compliant fulfillment of government orders
• Manage procurement workflows for both commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) items and government-specific configurations requiring anti-tampering, GPS tracking, RFID tagging, secure storage, and supply chain risk management protocols at WAS19
• Oversee Third Party Supplier Assessments (TPSAs) by ensuring engineers and sourcing leads provide required inputs and that assessments meet DFARS supply chain security requirements
• Manage complex interdependencies across procurement actions, engineering milestones, test venue requirements (e.g., Flatsat/HITL), and government delivery schedules
Security Clearance: This position requires that the selected candidate be a US Citizen and must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.
About the team
This Operational Program Manager will be the rocket fuel behind Amazon Leo's ability to win and deliver on DoD satellite communication contracts transforming complex government procurement requirements into compliant, executable actions with speed and precision that collapse cycle times from sales commitment to fulfilled delivery. As the critical bridge between Leo engineering teams and procurement execution, this role is the linchpin that builds DoD customer confidence in Leo's mission readiness, ironclad regulatory compliance, and proven ability to put operationally capable Low Earth Orbiting satellite systems, ground gateways, and customer terminals in the warfighter's hands on schedule and within contract terms.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

description:

You've owned end-to-end product vision for a shipping, delivery, or transportation product at scale, and you have a track record of turning operational networks into differentiated, customer-facing products that customers love and adopt to. You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable diving deep into transit-time and cutoff economics, network flow and injection constraints, coverage and lane profitability, pricing structure, and competitive benchmarking to decide where product and network investment drives outsized revenue and share impact. You understand that this is not project management — this is setting direction for a shipping product that competes head-to-head with industry leading services and must earn every shipper's choice.
High judgment is expected at the Principal bar: defining the product promise and service bar customer-back (not operations-forward), making trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer delight, deciding when to build versus influence a platform or operations team's roadmap, and influencing across operations, network design, commercial, finance, and engineering teams without direct authority. You set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to, you regularly engage with senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions, and you are relied on to be right a lot. You have a proven track record of building a transportation or delivery product that became a durable competitive advantage.
Key job responsibilities
Strategic Product Management — Define the executive-level vision for the Shipping Express 2-day product and translate it into actionable multi-year roadmaps aligned across operations, network design, product, commercial, and engineering. Define the product customer-back — product promise, cutoff times, guaranteed delivery windows, tracking/visibility SLAs, pickup experience, coverage footprint, service tiers, and pricing framework — benchmarked dimension by dimension against UPS 2nd Day Air and FedEx 2Day. Own end-to-end outcomes and business impact (shipper acquisition and retention, volume and share growth, delivery-performance SLAs, cost per shipment, and shipper satisfaction).
End-to-End Product Lifecycle & Quality Ownership — Own the full product cycle for Shipping Express and the quality of the product at every stage:
Vision — Set the long-term product vision and the "why now," grounded in customer need and competitive gap.
Requirements — Translate the vision into clear, prioritized product requirements that engineering and operations can build from.
Phased launch — Launch in deliberate phases (pilot → scale → expand), defining the entry and exit criteria for each phase rather than attempting a single big-bang release.
Measurement — Instrument the product and define the success metrics up front; measure actual performance against the product promise and the business case after each phase.
Quality improvement — Identify quality gaps from the data (service misses, exceptions, defects, failure modes) and drive the highest-impact improvements back into the product and network.
Product evolution — Continuously evolve the roadmap based on customer feedback, operational quality and cost, and P&L outcomes — deciding what to double down on, what to fix, and what to retire.
Cross-Team & Network Leadership — Lead product vision and execution across multi-org dependencies, driving alignment across network design, sort/injection operations, air gateway capacity, and middle-mile/last-mile execution. Translate hard operational constraints (pickup-to-injection timing, gateway cutoffs, sort-center flow) into a single recommended network path and a product customers can rely on. Eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the shipping journey; own the build-vs-influence calls and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home.
Operational Excellence & Scale — Design a product and the supporting network capabilities that scale with volume growth without proportional increases in manual exception handling. Use data to identify and eliminate the highest-impact friction points across the pickup-to-delivery experience and the lanes that drive cost and service risk. Build the governance and review mechanisms that keep cross-org investment aligned year over year.
A day in the life
Set the strategic direction for the Shipping Express product across teams — aligning operations, commercial, and engineering around a single customer-back product definition, not a stack of operational compromises.
Deep dive into data (transit-time and on-time performance, cutoff and injection constraints, lane profitability, competitive benchmarks, shipper feedback) to shape the roadmap and decide where to invest for maximum share and margin impact.
Run the product cycle end to end — move initiatives from vision to requirements to phased launch, then measure outcomes, surface quality gaps, and feed them back into the next iteration.
Partner with engineering and operations leaders to shape network and product design, ensuring the product scales with volume growth and holds its service promise.
Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting network and product progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and in the network to pressure-test whether the product performs for shippers in the real world.
What this takes
Someone who toggles between deep product and operational insight and strategic product leadership — owning the full product cycle from vision through launch, measurement, and continuous quality improvement — and turning a complex transportation network into a scalable, benchmark-beating 2-day shipping product that shippers choose.

- Partner with our central response team to improve response playbooks, escalation paths, and recovery actions for planned and unplanned events
- Partner with meteorologists to improve forecasting, feeding operational outcomes back into how forecasts are built
- Own the volume-versus-quality trade-off recommendation, sizing the cost of both over-reacting and under-reacting
- Build the tools and processes that let this program scale across the network
- Influence investment priorities through data-driven business cases, and drive alignment across operations, planning, finance, and technology partners

- Confidence in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

You partner with the central response team to prepare for upcoming events and with meteorologists to review where forecasts diverged from outcomes. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Ads AI Core Infrastructure
description:
Amazon Advertising is investing heavily in building AI-native data infrastructure, and our team sits at the center of that transformation. We own the Ads Real-Time Data Service and Advertiser Profiles: the systems that provide every advertising AI agent with immediate, structured access to advertiser context. Today, advertising agents and skills across Amazon depend on our platform to answer questions about campaign performance, budget allocation, brand positioning, and advertiser behavior within sub-second latency. We process billions of data points daily with 1-3 minute refresh cadences, serving millions of advertisers across all Amazon marketplaces worldwide.
Our team is part of Ads AI Core Infrastructure (ACI), the organization responsible for the foundational systems that make Amazon's advertising AI possible: knowledge bases, runtime environments, agent tooling, and the real-time data layer that connects them all. The programs you will lead span the full lifecycle: from defining the data model and onboarding new advertiser signal types, to coordinating cross-organization launches with agent teams, measurement systems, and advertising console experiences. You will own programs that touch 30+ engineering teams across 10 VP organizations, drive alignment between science teams developing new embedding and retrieval techniques and engineering teams productionizing them, and manage the rollout of platform capabilities to advertising agents and skills across Amazon's global advertising business. The work is technically complex (distributed systems, real-time streaming, large language model optimization), organizationally complex (multiple VP-level stakeholders with competing priorities), and time-sensitive (agent teams are shipping new advertiser experiences weekly and depend on our platform to keep pace).
Key job responsibilities
Program Strategy & Roadmap Ownership
You own the multi-quarter roadmap for Advertiser Data and Profiles across both our team and our partner teams. You define program milestones, success metrics, and delivery timelines. You write and present the program narrative for OP1/OP2 documents and monthly business reviews to Directors and VPs. You make data-driven trade-off recommendations when scope, resources, and timelines conflict, and you drive crisp decisions about what ships now versus what defers.
Cross-Organization Program Delivery
You manage programs spanning our platform engineering team, applied science teams building embedding and retrieval models, agent builder teams consuming our APIs, measurement and attribution teams depending on our data, and advertising console teams surfacing profile data to advertisers directly. You create and maintain program schedules that account for cross-team dependencies, negotiate resource commitments, and drive weekly execution cadence across all workstreams. When programs stall, you diagnose whether the block is technical, organizational, or resource-based, and you drive resolution through the appropriate path.
Technical Program Leadership
You understand distributed systems architecture well enough to participate in design reviews, challenge assumptions about data freshness and consistency guarantees, and ensure that what we commit to delivering is technically feasible within the stated timeline. You work with engineers to decompose large programs into independently deliverable milestones. You ensure that real-time ingestion pipelines, MCP server infrastructure, and profile computation systems meet their availability and latency commitments. You own the launch readiness process for platform features consumed by 30+ downstream teams.
Operational Excellence & Risk Management
You establish and maintain the mechanisms that keep programs healthy: status dashboards, weekly program reviews, escalation criteria, and stakeholder communication cadences. You proactively identify risks weeks before they become blockers and bring mitigation plans. You run retrospectives after major launches and drive the resulting improvements into team process. You own capacity planning coordination across our services during peak advertising seasons.
Stakeholder Communication & Influence
You are the single-threaded owner of program communication to senior leadership. You write documents that clearly articulate scope, timeline, risk, and trade-offs for Directors and VPs. You present at monthly business reviews and operational reviews. You build consensus across teams with different priorities by finding the framing that connects each team's goals to the program outcome. You manage expectations proactively, ensuring leadership is never surprised by delays or scope changes.
A day in the life
Morning: Program Execution and Unblocking
Your day starts with the program dashboard showing 3 of 4 workstreams green and one yellow: the real-time campaign ingestion pipeline is blocked on a schema change from the upstream data warehouse team. You write a concise status update to your Director with the issue, impact to timeline, and your proposed mitigation. You then join a 30-minute stand-up with your cross-team leads where you confirm the data warehouse team has scheduled the schema migration for next sprint. You update the program tracker, adjust the downstream timeline by 3 days, and notify the agent teams that their new campaign signals onboarding date shifted.
Mid-morning, you are in a design review with the platform engineers and an Applied Scientist. They are proposing a new context compression approach for high-cardinality advertiser data that would reduce token consumption by 35% but requires changes to the MCP server response format. You ask questions about backward compatibility, migration path for existing consumers, and latency impact. You determine this needs a phased rollout and work with the team to define the phases and success criteria for each.
Afternoon: Strategic Planning and Stakeholder Alignment
After lunch, you are drafting the Q4 roadmap section for the OP1 narrative. You are framing the Advertiser Profiles expansion in terms of what it enables for advertisers (richer recommendations, faster onboarding to new ad products) rather than the technical components. You coordinate with the product manager on the customer-facing narrative and with the science lead on which profile signals will be ready by launch.
You join a weekly sync with the three agent teams that are your largest consumers. They want real-time access to advertiser creative assets as part of the profile. You assess the engineering cost, negotiate a phased delivery (metadata first, full assets in Q1), and commit to a date for the first phase. You document the agreement and add the work items to the backlog.
Late Afternoon: Operational Reviews and Forward Planning
You run a 45-minute program review with your Director and the partner team leads. You walk through each workstream: what shipped this week, what ships next week, where the risks are. One risk surfaces: the data warehouse team is planning a schema migration that could disrupt our ingestion pipelines during peak season. You escalate this to your VP with a clear ask (timing coordination) and a proposed resolution path.
Before end of day, you review the launch readiness checklist for next week's release of a new profile data type to all advertising agents. Load testing passed, documentation is complete, the rollback plan is reviewed. You approve the launch and send the go/no-go communication to stakeholders.

title: AI Software Engineer, App Intelligence
description:

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.
This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.
Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in technical subject area with minimum 10 years of proven experience or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: Deep knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
Deep knowledge in developing scalable and portable test-benches
Strong experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewers, Build and run automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations
Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
Excellent knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
Experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required
Knowledge of emulation for verification technologies is a plus but not required

Excellent project management skills including structuring programs with multiple interdependent workstreams.

title: Engineering Program Manager- SoftGoods
description:
Why Apple?
At Apple we believe our products begin with our people. By hiring a diverse team we drive creative thought. By giving that team everything they need we drive innovation. By hiring incredible engineers we drive precision. And through our collaborative process we create memorable experiences for our customers.
These elements come together to make Apple an amazing environment for motivated people to do the greatest work of their lives. products?

Bringing Apple engineering and precision to products made of soft materials is an exciting challenge and requires a creative and open-minded approach. We have a talented team of people from a wide variety of backgrounds. We all work together in a beautiful customized lab where we design, engineer and develop the best softgoods products in the world.

Your role will include coordinating with Product Design, Industrial Design (ID), Operations, Reliability and other key cross functional teams. relationships across high-energy teams.
You will work closely with manufacturing suppliers and OEM partners.
The role will require up to 20% international travel to support
manufacturing builds in Asia.

Project management experience related to developing computer accessories or related consumer products
Experience working closely with product design and other cross functional teams to drive closure of technical issues and communicate risk
Experience creating schedules, managing program finances, and tracking budget
Experience fostering relationships with manufacturing suppliers and coordinating development builds
You are someone who is analytical, professionally assertive, and exhibit excellent attention to detail
Strong verbal & written communication and executive level presentation skills
You exhibit a deeply curious mindset about new ideas
Preferred qualifications: Experience as a practicing mechanical engineer or related product development role prior to becoming a project manager
Experience working with industrial designers or other similarly creative product developers
Prior experience working with soft goods materials and processes (synthetics, textiles)
Prior experience traveling internationally to work closely with manufacturing suppliers

title: Environment, Health and Safety(EHS) Lead
description:
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen, we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. We develop and manage Apple’s global real estate portfolio, lead all related capital construction projects, provide outstanding facilities and site services, develop and lead sustainability initiatives to reduce the environmental impact of all Apple facilities, including commute and renewable energy programs, and do everything we can to ensure the health and safety of all Apple personnel, facilities, and customers in our facilities around the world.
The Apple Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) team is committed to protecting the environment, health, and safety of our employees, contractors, customers, and the global communities where we operate. We partner across Apple to anticipate, assess, and control workplace hazards, support occupational health, and uphold rigorous environmental compliance across our facilities. By embedding proactive safety standards and environmental protections into dynamic environments, we empower our teams in their mission to develop extraordinary products responsibly.
We are seeking an inventive, collaborative, and highly organized professional to join our team as an EHS Lead to provide comprehensive EHS support and foster operational excellence across a diverse portfolio of workplace environments, including corporate offices, event spaces, logistics hubs, facilities and infrastructure, and research and development laboratories.

Your work will support strong infrastructure manageability, serviceability, and security.

Exposure to EDKII/BIOS and platform enablement.

title: Fitness Tools & Automation Engineer, Watch Software, Sensing & Connectivity
description:
The Fitness team is shaping the future of personal health and activity across watchOS and iOS. title: Hardware Systems Design & Integration Engineer - AirPods
description:

title: Learning Analytics Data Scientist, Employee Experience & Productivity, IS&T
description:
The difference between data and intelligence is context. This role enriches data with business context to produce insights that enable intelligent decisions. Join Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine powering Apple. As a member of the Employee Productivity & Support Data Science team, you will use data to improve how Apple trains its employees and delivers knowledge resources. You will pull and prepare data from multiple systems, build dashboards and visualizations, and conduct analyses that help learning and development leaders understand program effectiveness and make informed decisions. This role is about interpreting data, extracting insights, and partnering closely with the business to turn those insights into better decisions.
In this role, you will support IS&T's Knowledge & Training group by building and maintaining the analytical assets it relies on — dashboards, reports, and ad-hoc analyses that surface how training programs and knowledge resources are performing across the organization. You will draw on your expertise in learning and development analytics to understand how employees engage with training content, identify where programs can improve, and develop metrics that measure effectiveness beyond attendance. A core part of the role is partnership: you will work directly with knowledge and training leaders to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical work, and deliver findings that are clear, accurate, and actionable. You are not building in isolation — you are a thought partner who understands the business well enough to know what to measure and why it matters. Day to day, you will write SQL to model data from large datasets, build and maintain Tableau dashboards, conduct analyses to identify trends and anomalies, and present your findings to stakeholders at various levels — all while using AI tools to accelerate your analytical work. The ideal candidate is someone who is technically strong, detail-oriented, and equally motivated by the work the data enables as by the data itself.
Minimum qualifications: 3+ years of experience working with learning and development data, including training platforms, content performance metrics, or learner engagement data.
3+ years of hands-on experience writing SQL to extract, transform, and analyze data from large, multi-source datasets.
3+ years of experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
1+ years of experience in Python or R for data manipulation and analysis.
3+ years of experience delivering analytical work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and multiple concurrent stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related quantitative field — or a Master's degree in a quantitative or business discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience.
Preferred qualifications: Working knowledge of how data informs content strategy, curriculum design, and self-service enablement.
Working knowledge of clickstream data and web analytics as applied to content performance and user engagement measurement.
Proficiency in version control and collaborative documentation practices using tools like GitHub.
Knowledge of statistical modeling, including hypothesis testing, regression, and foundational causal inference methods.
Track record of applying AI to real-world data analytics and general productivity challenges.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, adapting depth and format to the situation.
Comfort with ambiguity; ability to define the analytical approach when the business question is loosely framed.
Proven ability to build trust with leaders across diverse functional areas.
Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, data science, economics, operations research, applied mathematics, the natural sciences, or an MBA with analytics concentration)

title: ML - Data Scientist
description:
Do you want to decide whether a generative imaging feature is good enough to ship? Our team evaluates generative image and video features. These features reach a very large number of people on Apple devices. You will build the evaluation systems, human-annotation programs, and automated metrics that turn "this looks better" into measurable, trustworthy quality signals. Those signals guide model development and release decisions.
You'll own quality evaluation end to end — from evaluation set design through annotation, scoring, analysis, and the recommendations that shape what engineering and product build next. Your findings determine which models ship.
What you'll do
Build the measurement foundation. Design and maintain golden sets and evaluation sets, analyzing data distributions so results stay representative and known defects stay covered.
Run human evaluation at quality. Write and iterate annotation guidelines and label schemas, build or adapt lightweight labeling tools for image and video review, monitor annotator quality, and resolve disagreements and guideline ambiguity.
Automate the repeatable parts. Develop automated metrics and LLM-as-judge systems, calibrate them against human labels, and track where they diverge.
Make the results decision-ready. Report model-vs-model comparisons with confidence intervals, significance testing, and breakdowns by hotspot, content type, and failure mode — then turn them into root-cause findings and prioritized recommendations.
Set the bar with your partners. Work with ML, engineering, and design to define quality standards, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
Minimum qualifications: MS and a minimum of 5 years relevant industry experience
5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning evaluation, algorithm analysis, or related technical disciplines.
Experience designing and analyzing evaluations and experiments, especially for ML or generative model quality. This includes sampling design, significance testing, and confidence intervals.
Strong Python skills and comfort with SQL, with the ability to build and maintain evaluation pipelines and small tools.
Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis workflows, foundation models, agentic systems, or intelligent automation approaches for technical problem solving.
Preferred qualifications: Experience evaluating 3D Gaussian splats or diffusion models, or assessing perceptual quality.
Experience building LLM or VLM judges and validating them against human ratings.
Experience building web-based labeling or review tools.
Ability to run several work-streams in parallel and prioritize them.
Proven cross-functional collaboration and the ability to learn new tools quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication, including explaining statistical tradeoffs to engineers and product partners.

title: Machine Learning Compiler Engineer
description:

title: Machine Learning Research Engineer, Pretraining Data — Foundation Models
description:
Apple is revolutionizing artificial intelligence by developing sophisticated foundation models that power intelligent features across our product ecosystem. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.

title: Strategic Design Engineering, Global Supply Manager - Mechanicals
description:
Imagine what you could do here… At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.
The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it.
We are part of Apple’s Beats Org and will work closely with cross-functional teams to help launch innovative yet cost-efficient products on ambitious timelines.
Mechanical components define the look, feel and expression of Beats’ unique brand within Apple; they are also integral to product performance and reliability. This role will be directly responsible for working with engineering to guide design for manufacturability and cost, defining sustainable sourcing strategy by factoring in cross-functional inputs, and developing robust working relationships with internal (cross-functional) and external (supplier) partners towards helping execute for cost, quality, capacity, supply.
Successful SDE GSMs thrive in a rapidly changing environment and constantly drive excellence across their own responsibilities as well as that of team members and partners. They frequently leverage strategic internal relationships to effectively collaborate with engineering, operations and other Apple teams. They are able to make smart decisions with the information available, think and stay focused under pressure, and communicate concisely and effectively with senior management as well as peers.
*Engage with engineering teams during early product development phases to drive overall architecture towards the right cost by providing quick feedback on baseline architecture, challenging teams on underlying assumptions, and helping identify and evaluate alternatives
*Where relevant, work with early development supplier partners to help define overall architecture, while still balancing for cost
*Investigate and propose alternative manufacturing processes, materials, designs, and suppliers that optimize cost for our x-functional engineering partners
*Manage overall mechanicals cost BOM, and influence cross-functional teams to validate and implement creative alternatives needed to meet cost target
*Collaborate closely with partners in Ops to understand down-stream (FATP) impact of upstream design decisions, and work closely with Engineering teams and supplier partners to optimize
*Identify the right supplier partners to work with (and think broadly, about the right strategy) to secure product quality, supply, and long-term cost-competitiveness, all on an aggressive, timeline
*Develop supplier relationships to “train” vendor mind-sets to align with strategic organizational needs
*Identify and drive “special projects” related to costs, and develop into scalable cost solutions that can be applied across various Apple products over time
*Liaise between operational cross-functional teams and operations-focused GSM teammates as needed, to support quality, capacity, and supply
Minimum qualifications: BS in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or related engineering field
Intimate knowledge / understanding of a typical stage/gate product development process
Strong technical background, with an ability to quickly understand various aspects of a product’s design, and the manufacturing processes necessary to materialize the design, and assembly and testing steps needed to execute it at scale
Factory experience, particularly related to forming and finishing processes related to plastics, composites, and metal

Strong PM-ing skills… ability to manage wide and diverse activities with disparate stakeholders, by focusing on key deliverables and effectively driving next steps

Excellent soft skills; flexibility to adapt to dynamic and rapidly changing environments
Ability to travel ~20% internationally, ~30% domestically

Product design exposure or experience, with a deep interest in designing for cost

Experience working across functions (Industrial design, Product design, Manufacturing design, Operations), and with suppliers… ability to influence across multi-functional teams
Top-notch analytical skills, with ability to toggle between detail-orientated and strategic, large-picture thinking
“Team lead” experience, guiding / leading less experienced teammates within subject matter area

title: Support Operations Data Analyst, Employee Experience & Productivity, IS&T
description:
The difference between data and intelligence is context. This role enriches data with business context to produce insights that enable intelligent decisions. Join Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine powering Apple. As a member of the Employee Productivity & Support Data Science team, you will use data to improve how Apple delivers technical support to its employees. You will pull and prepare data from multiple systems, build dashboards and visualizations, and conduct analyses that help IT support leaders understand operational performance and make informed decisions. This role is about interpreting data, extracting insights, and partnering closely with the business to turn those insights into better decisions.
In this role, you will support the IS&T Support organization by building and maintaining the analytical assets it relies on — dashboards, reports, and ad-hoc analyses that surface how the support ecosystem is performing across a variety of support channels. You will draw on your expertise in IT support analytics to understand how employees seek help, identify where processes can improve, and develop metrics that measure operational efficiency and service quality. A core part of the role is partnership: you will work directly with support leaders and operational managers to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical work, and deliver findings that are clear, accurate, and actionable. You are not building in isolation — you are a thought partner who understands the business well enough to know what to measure and why it matters. Day to day, you will write SQL to model data from large datasets, build and maintain Tableau dashboards, conduct analyses to identify trends and anomalies, and present your findings to stakeholders at various levels — all while using AI tools to accelerate your analytical work. The ideal candidate is someone who is technically strong, detail-oriented, and equally motivated by the work the data enables as by the data itself.
Minimum qualifications: 3+ years of experience working with IT support data, including ticketing systems, contact center platforms, or multi-channel interaction data.
3+ years of hands-on experience writing SQL to extract, transform, and analyze data from large, multi-source datasets.
3+ years of experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.
1+ years of experience in Python or R for data manipulation and analysis.
3+ years of experience delivering analytical work in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and multiple concurrent stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related quantitative field — or a Master's degree in a quantitative or business discipline with 2+ years of relevant experience.
Preferred qualifications: Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative or business field (e.g., statistics, data science, economics, operations research, applied mathematics, the natural sciences, or an MBA with analytics concentration)
Working knowledge of support operations and how data informs staffing models, triage optimization, and process improvement.
Working knowledge of clickstream data and web analytics as applied to content or service performance measurement.
Proficiency in version control and collaborative documentation practices using tools like GitHub.
Knowledge of statistical modeling, including hypothesis testing, regression, and foundational causal inference methods.
Track record of applying AI to real-world data analytics and general productivity challenges.
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, adapting depth and format to the situation.
Comfort with ambiguity; ability to define the analytical approach when the business question is loosely framed.
Proven ability to build trust with leaders across diverse functional areas.

title: Tactile AI Research Engineer - Special Projects (Robotics)
description:
We are seeking research scientists and engineers with strong backgrounds across mechatronics, controls, haptics, robotics, simulation, and machine learning to drive breakthrough innovations in intelligent robotic systems. This position requires a hands-on approach, integrating software and hardware solutions to push the boundaries of perception, control, and intelligence. You will work alongside world-class researchers and engineers, contributing to technologies that power the Apple ecosystem.
We are a team of best-in-the-world research scientists and engineers with deep experience in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, haptics, and related areas. We work on exciting new technologies that bring joy to millions of people. In our daily work, the team stays innovative, productive, and fun by sharing some key values:

6+ years of relevant experience in robotics and machine learning.
Strong proficiency in Python and C++ with experience in complex, multi-language systems.

Strong software engineering skills, delivering clean, well-tested, and optimized code.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
BS, MS, or PhD degree in Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Preferred qualifications: Functional understanding of tactile sensing and haptics technologies to solve challenges in interaction and manipulation.
Strong foundation in robot kinematics, dynamics, motion planning, and control.
Experience with a wide range of physics simulation software and their contact mechanics (e.g. Mujoco, IssacLab simulator, Drake, etc.).
Successful record of employing machine learning techniques to achieve useful system performance.

title: Technical Accounting Manager
description:

description:

You will bring deep knowledge of Apple platforms and a hands-on approach to a fast-moving environment where no two days look alike. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to make sure each launch is ready for the world stage.
This role suits a collaborative, self-directed problem solver who takes pride in the details that make a product shine.

Experience with mass deployment techniques and best practices for iOS and macOS, as well as large-scale system administration

A solution-oriented mindset and high-level programming skills

Experience building scalable databases
A creative and ambitious approach to problem-solving
Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

title: Test & Instrumentation Development Engineer
description:
The Instrumentation and Test technology team architects and designs best-in-class, end-to-end test and measurements systems.
We are a collaborative group of creative and thoughtful people developing highly complex and sophisticated systems to validate the performance of sensors and other critical technologies in our world-class products.
This individual will play a key role in designing comprehensive test strategies, methodologies, and integrating the measurement systems to support new product introduction, characterization, ramp, and mass production. This includes everything from defining high level test plans to architecting the specific instruments required to execute them.
You will play a key role in architecting, designing, and deploying the complete test solutions—including hardware, software, and algorithms—for our next-generation products. Partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional teams, you will develop the critical test methodologies and instrumentation needed for system characterization, calibration, and validation in a fast-paced and collaborative product development environment.
Minimum qualifications: Our ideal candidate has experience in test integration, implementation, and has a strong foundation in at least one of the following core areas: system or application-level test software or instrumentation hardware design.
Minimum of bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) with 10 years of relevant industry experience in a hands-on technical role.
3+ years of experience in a programming language like C/C++ or Python
Preferred qualifications: End-to-end Test Design: Experience creating and documenting comprehensive test plans, defining test cases and coverage, and developing validation methodologies for complex systems.
International Travel: This role requires international travel (up to 25%) to support our manufacturing partners during key product builds. This typically involves 2-4 trips per year at sites in Asia. Our team is committed to providing as much advance notice as possible to support your planning.
Curiosity and Adaptability: You are driven by curiosity, energized by solving novel problems, and motivated to learn new skills to get the job done.
Focused Problem Solving: You excel at identifying the most critical variables in a complex system and can develop a clear, focused plan of action even when all the details are not yet available.
Hands-on experience with electronics debugging tools.
Electrical engineering fundamentals (ability to read schematics & layout & component datasheets).
You have experience developing robust software and algorithms in a modern object-oriented or scripting language (e.g., Python, C++). Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem is a plus but not required.
Background in testing high-volume consumer electronics, particularly with Touch, Sensing, Display, or other complex user-facing technologies.
Knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP) or image processing algorithms.
Experience with instrument camera and optical capture system is a plus.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and design teams.
Passion for learning and contributing across disciplines.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Excellent skills in debugging and performing failure analysis across software, hardware and system domains. Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies like Design of Experiments (DOE). Ability to perform and interpret statistical data analysis.
Master's degree preferred.

title: Tools & Automation Backend Quality Engineer – App Store Analytics
description:
The App Store Analytics Quality Engineering team ensures the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of customer experience data that powers features and insights across the App Store ecosystem. We are seeking a test automation engineer with strong experience in Big Data environments (Spark, Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Hive, Iceberg), backend, and UI service testing and the ability to build scalable, robust test automation using Java or Python.
This role is central to ensuring quality throughout the data lifecycle — from client instrumentation to backend aggregation and reporting dashboard — by applying shift-left testing principles, embedding quality checks early in development, and integrating test automation within CI/CD pipelines.
In this role, you will drive quality for large-scale distributed data systems that power App Store analytics. You will collaborate closely with engineering, data, and program management teams to define test strategies, drive testing automation development, and ensure high data quality across ingestion, transformation, reporting, and UI layers. You will be responsible for:
* Implementing and maintaining automated validation frameworks for data pipelines, backend and frontend services.
* Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous feedback and early defect detection.
* Partnering with developers to shift quality left by embedding testability into data workflows, APIs, and UI dashboard.
* Ensuring consistency and correctness of client-to-backend data flows across iOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, and Web.
This role requires a self-driven engineer with strong technical depth, solid analytical skills, and the ability to influence quality across complex, evolving systems.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar fields.
At least 7+ years industry experience in a similar role.
Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend, frontend, data pipeline test automation.
Working knowledge of SQL and large-scale dataset validation across distributed storage or data lake environments.
Experience with REST API testing and test automation.
Experience with UI testing and test automation.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing frameworks.
Proven experience implementing Shift-Left testing practices and embedding automation early in the SDLC.
Strong analytical, debugging, and communication skills.

title: US Channel Cross-Functional Experiences and Platform Manager
description:
Marcom is the creatively-led global team that oversees Apple's consumer-facing marketing. We ensure the flawless development and execution of world-class communications across all media and platforms. Every day, hundreds of millions of Apple customers around the world interact with our products. We drive the strategy and creative work that provide both new and existing customers with simple, engaging, and inspiring marketing experiences.
The Channel team within Apple's Worldwide Marketing Communications group is responsible for developing go-to-market strategies that deliver against both marketing strategies and channel commercial objectives. The US Channel Cross-Functional (XF) Experiences and Platform Manager defines and drives the strategy for Apple's presence across partner retail environments in the United States — spanning physical store experiences, digital platforms, merchandising, and fixturing. Working in close partnership with Worldwide counterparts and US Sales, this role ensures US strategies are informed by global best practices, aligned to commercial priorities, and tailored to the unique dynamics of the US retail landscape. This role helps inform how we bring Apple's products and services to life across every touchpoint, ensuring a cohesive and premium customer journey that deepens engagement and drives conversion.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years of experience in retail marketing, store experience strategy, or experiential marketing (strategy, planning, account or project management) with a leading agency or in-house marketing organization.
At least 3 years in a leadership and people management role.
Proven track record of conceiving and executing world-class, transformative retail experiences at scale.
Deep understanding of the full retail experience spectrum — physical store environments, merchandising, fixturing, digital in-store, and e-commerce platforms — and how these touch-points shape the customer journey.
Experience developing and delivering successful brand strategies across multiple channels.

A strong leader with a consistent record of building, developing, and leading high-performing teams, with the ability to optimize how the team works.

title: US-Business Pro
description:
Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only-at-Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.
As a Business Pro, you’re part of a team that’s passionate about helping businesses succeed. The Business Pro develops and grows relationships with high-potential business customers, and builds loyalty by maintaining those relationships. You have strong business and sales acumen, and knowledge of Apple products and services, key Small Medium Business (SMB) industries, business challenges, and trends in your local community.
You serve as a resource and mentor for the broader team, and help support an environment where business is integrated into Apple Retail’s culture. You partner with leadership to find opportunities to connect customers with powerful tools and solutions that help their businesses thrive.
Establish and engage business customers by showcasing our technology. Help them discover how Apple and third-party products and solutions can enhance and support their businesses and enrich the lives of their customers and employees.
Proactively engage with and provide excellent customer service to Apple Retail Business customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating them on relevant ways to buy.
Serve as the go-to expert on business solutions, and mentor the team on business customer needs and solutions.
Collaborate in business sessions, briefings, workshops, and events by identifying and recommending unique offerings to fit customers’ business needs.
Partner with leadership and cross-functional partners to transition accounts in line with account engagement strategy to help create a seamless customer experience.
Strategize, plan, and forecast business performance through account management, pipeline building, and opportunity management, using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and other tools.
Maintain process mastery of all Retail Business programs and offerings to guarantee compliance with policies and procedures.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in your line of business.
