title: Brand Strategy Lead
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Brand Strategy Lead to own the Base brand as we grow into the country’s most beloved energy company.

 

Base started by serving early adopters in Texas. Now we’re bringing reliable, affordable home backup to households who have never heard of us. That takes a brand built on a deep understanding of our members, and it takes campaigns that turn that understanding into growth.

 

You will be the owner of brand strategy at Base. You’ll build the research systems that make you the voice of the member. You’ll write the positioning that every touchpoint is built on, and you’ll lead the brand campaigns that introduce Base to new markets. You’ll work closely with design, growth, sales, and leadership. You’ll get the strategy right, and you’ll make sure the work ships.

 

This role is for a strategist who is also a doer. You have strong opinions on brand, you can back them up with data, and you hold every campaign to a number.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and run research systems that show how our members think, decide, and talk about Base, using sales call recordings, social listening, qualitative interviews, and quantitative surveys

 - Turn research into sharp insights and campaign strategies, and be the voice of the member across the company

 - Partner with design as a thought partner to build creative that stays true to the brand and also moves it forward

 - Write clear, distinctive positioning for each product and market, and keep it consistent across every marketing touchpoint

 - Lead integrated brand campaigns from brief to launch, including market launches in new states

 - Test creative concepts with real audiences before committing media spend

 - Set campaign goals tied to business outcomes

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6+ years of experience in brand strategy, strategic planning, or brand marketing, at an agency, a consumer brand, or both

 - A portfolio of integrated campaigns you led from strategy through execution, with clear results

 - Hands-on experience running qualitative and quantitative research and turning it into positioning

 - Strong creative taste and the ability to give clear, useful direction to designers and creative partners

 - Comfort working through a full funnel, from awareness to signup, and building an ideal customer profile (ICP) from data

 - A doer’s mentality: you write the brief, sit in on sales calls, and stay close to the work

 - First principles thinking, grit, and a bias toward shipping

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

The Marketing team owns how homeowners first hear about Base, come to understand it, and decide to join. Most of the people we reach have never thought about where their power comes from until it goes out. Our job is to make a new kind of power company feel simple, credible, and obvious. We work side by side with sales, product, and design, and our results directly decide how fast Base can grow into new markets.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

title: Deployment Partner
description:
About CADDi
CADDi is the Manufacturing AI Data Platform transforming a trillion-dollar global industry. By unifying fragmented engineering, procurement, production, and quality data, we empower enterprise manufacturers and their AI agents to make faster, smarter decisions every day.
Founded in 2017 with dual headquarters in Chicago and Tokyo, CADDi serves manufacturing leaders across more than 20 countries. We recently announced a $114M Series D funding round at a $1.2B valuation, bringing total funding to $234M, backed by top-tier investors including Salesforce Ventures, Woven Capital, and Atomico.
We are expanding our North American operations rapidly and building next-generation products like CADDi Explorer and CADDi Agent. If you are eager to solve hard data and engineering problems while scaling a fast-growing unicorn, we’d love to talk.
The role
As a Deployment Partner, you own a customer from first discovery through a live, adopted workflow, and then through expansion across the enterprise. You work directly with the people who run the plant floor, procurement, quality, and engineering from operational management up to the C-suite deciding where AI fits in their business.
You work with the CADDi AI Data Platform and suite of workflow-specific products a configurable tool you capitalize on for each customer. You are accountable for their success end-to-end: time-to-value, the deployment of the solutions we promised, the measurable value they see enterprise-wide, and the renewal that follows.
The role folds pre-sales, customer success, and data expertise into a single owner, working alongside an Account Executive on the commercial side and Forward Deployed Engineers who build the technical pieces beyond what you configure.
What you’ll do
Understand the customer
Meet with cross-functional teams across engineering, procurement, quality, and operations onsite as needed to learn how they work and where time and money are lost.
Advise customer leaders, from operational management to the C-suite, on where AI and a shared data foundation create the most value, and agree on what success means for their business.
Identify the data that matters (drawings, quotes, part records, supplier data) and model it into the platform, working with Forward Deployed Engineers where deeper integration is needed.
Partner with Sales before the deal closes to validate value with real customer data and show an early, concrete win. Build and deliver tailored demos for prospects and existing customers.
Deploy and drive adoption
Own the deployment plan from scoping to production, coordinating customer stakeholders across business units, IT, procurement, and compliance.
Define the semantic layer for the customer’s data, configure the data layer, and build the Explorer configuration and plugins the deployment needs, reusing existing configurations, plugins, and libraries wherever possible to move fast.
Deploy CADDi’s workflow products for each user group and shape deployments of CADDi Agent, run training and adoption sessions
Orchestrate Forward Deployed Engineers on the technical gap between the standard platform and what the customer needs, such as data pipelines, custom integrations, and advanced analytics.
Define the success metrics and quality bar for each deployment, track them, and run QBRs to customer and CADDi leadership.
Own operations after go-live and grow the account
Own the operational health of every live deployment, so environments, data pipelines, configurations, and access stay reliable as the customer’s data, users, and processes change
Design and quantify ROI, and present findings to audiences from shop-floor users to the executive team to drive decisions and action.
Identify expansion opportunities within accounts and work with the Account Executive to turn them into new business, including upsell, cross-sell, and global rollout.
Bring what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering so it shapes the roadmap, and return reusable configurations and learnings to the shared library so the next deployment is faster.
What we value
Curiosity and ownership: you keep digging past the first answer, and you follow through on every one of several complex, visible projects at once.
Comfort with ambiguity: you do your best work in messy, unstructured customer environments, and you know when to lead and when to support.
Bias for speed: you would rather put something real in front of users this week than something perfect next quarter.
Levels What
We hire this role at two levels. Deployment Partners own standard deployments end-to-end and drive adoption and expansion. Lead Deployment Partners take the deepest, most strategic accounts, leading value validation, designing the technical solution, orchestrating Forward Deployed Engineers, and driving change at the executive level. Tell us which fits you, or let us help you figure it out.
Requirements
What we’re looking for
8+ years in a customer-facing technical role (solutions consulting, implementation, forward-deployed engineering, analytics consulting, or similar), with a track record of owning complex deployments end-to-end and driving measurable adoption and expansion.
Strong written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, from operational management up to the C-suite.
Comfort structuring messy, multi-source data into clear models defining semantics and relationships is central to this role. CF
Working knowledge of Python, SQL, or similar tools for exploring data, and comfort reading API documentation and discussing system architecture with engineers, is a nice-to-have.
Manufacturing, industrial, or supply chain experience is a plus.
Willingness to work from our Chicago office and travel [40–60%].
Bilingual Japanese/English is a plus.
US Person status / ITAR eligibility is a plus.
Benefits
Compensation
Work environment: In-office five days a week at our Chicago, IL office.
Travel: Occasional travel to customer sites may be required.
Authorization: Must be a U.S. citizen or a Permanent Resident (Green Card holder).
Compensation:
DP: OTE $195-225k
Equity: yes

The Atlanta Journal-Constitution is one of the most storied brands in journalism, with a legacy that stretches back more than a century. Our MISSION is to be the most essential and engaging source of news for the people of Atlanta, Georgia and the South, and we have a vision to transform this great institution into a modern media company.
That’s where you come in.
We are looking for a photojournalist who can capture the people, places and moments that define Georgia every day.
This is a field-based, general assignment journalism role for a photographer. You will work across local news, investigations, politics, education, features, entertainment and sports, including high school, college and professional teams. Your photography will reach audiences across our digital and social platforms.
You will have the opportunity to work alongside some of the most accomplished journalists in the South and produce distinctive visual storytelling. You'll tell stories across metro Atlanta and parts of Georgia, from our home base in one of the nation's most dynamic and fastest-growing cities.
A successful candidate is a journalist first, with exceptional visual instincts, strong news judgment and the ability to make memorable photographs in unpredictable and fast-moving situations.
Some of your job responsibilities:
Photograph daily assignments and breaking news across metro Atlanta and throughout Georgia, including coverage connected to our bureaus in Savannah, Athens and Macon.
Produce compelling original photography across a wide range of coverage areas, including news, politics, sports, entertainment, culture, features, investigations and enterprise journalism.
Respond quickly to breaking and developing news while exercising strong independent editorial judgment in the field.
Work with reporters, editors and other visual journalists to develop creative approaches to daily and enterprise stories.
Photograph major events, including elections, political events, protests, severe weather, major breaking news and high-profile sporting events.
Be prepared to travel throughout Georgia and occasionally beyond the state as coverage demands.
Deliver, edit and transmit photographs quickly and reliably from the field, often under tight deadlines.
Write accurate, AP-stye captions and metadata that meet the AJC's journalistic and ethical standards.
Collaborate with the AJC's video, social, graphics and digital teams when stories lend themselves to broader visual treatment.
Stay current on photographic technology, visual storytelling techniques and evolving audience behaviors.
Work a flexible schedule that may include early mornings, nights, weekends and holidays as news and major events require.
Develop longer-term visual stories and photo essays that illuminate the people, communities and issues shaping Georgia in conjunction with input from visual editors.
The qualifications and experience you should have:
Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and 2 years’ experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as a master’s degree and up to 2 years’ experience; or 6 years’ experience in a related field.
A portfolio demonstrating exceptional news photography, documentary storytelling and visual range.
Proven ability to photograph breaking news and work effectively in fast-moving, unpredictable situations.
Experience covering high-profile events such as elections, political campaigns or conventions, demonstrations, severe weather or other major news. Experience covering major sporting events is a plus
Strong editorial judgment and a deep understanding of the principles and ethics of photojournalism.
Demonstrated ability to find strong photographs and visual stories beyond the obvious or expected image.

Excellent reporting, communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work sensitively with people experiencing difficult or traumatic circumstances.

description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
Job Description:
About Crowe AI
Everything we do is about making the future of human work more purposeful. We do this by leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning, generative AI, modern architectures, and industry experts to create AI-powered solutions that transform the way we do business.
Our world-class AI and ML professionals give Crowe the ability to capture and harness the power of data. A combination of AI and Machine Learning Engineers and AI Platform and Infrastructure Engineers create and deploy AI functionality to solve complex problems. We focus on building scalable AI solutions, based on rigorous data exploration, validation via proof-of-concept buildout, and close partnership with subject matter experts across business areas.
The future is powered by AI, come build it with us.
Role Overview
Crowe’s Studio team is seeking an AI Tech Lead to serve as a hands-on technical leader for the design, development, and lifecycle management of AI agents that accelerate the delivery of Crowe’s Audit services. This role is built around Crowe’s forward deployed engineer (FDE) model: rather than sitting above a project as a traditional program manager, this person sits with Audit practitioners, learns the workflow, designs the agent as it is built, and owns the outcome end to end. The goal is to establish the technical patterns, Skills-based architecture, and engineering practices needed to support a growing portfolio of agents. As that portfolio grows, the role is expected to grow into leading a small team as an engineering manager with full-stack engineers who each own a slice of the roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
Delivery of Audit AI Agents
Own the design, development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of AI agents and agent-assisted workflows that accelerate the execution of common tasks across Crowe’s Audit practice.
Operate as a forward deployed engineer paired directly with an Audit SME — sitting with practitioners, learning the workflow firsthand, and designing the agent as it is built rather than from a static spec.
Remain hands-on in development: write, review, test, and maintain substantial Python codebases and the Skills, instructions, prompts, and supporting resources that define agent behavior.

Identify and fix bugs and issues in the codebase.
Assist in the development and execution of test plans, test cases, and test scripts.

Share knowledge and best practices with the development team and the broader organization.

Troubleshoot and debug issues in the NetSuite system and custom code.

Engage with clients to understand their technical needs and provide solutions that meet their requirements.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted technical advisor.

Provide ongoing support and assistance to clients to ensure successful user adoption.

Participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning and status updates.

Continuously improve development skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and self-study.

Follow established development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices.
Ensure code quality and maintainability through code reviews and adherence to development processes.

Develop a strong understanding of the client's business processes and how they align with NetSuite capabilities.
Recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

NetSuite Expertise: Basic understanding of the NetSuite ERP platform and its capabilities.

Job Description:

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

This role focuses on leading and supporting privacy gap assessments, as well as assisting clients with the implementation and optimization of privacy technology platforms that support key privacy program functions, including consumer rights request management, personal data inventories, consent management, and similar regulatory compliance obligations.
At Crowe, we empower our professionals to challenge themselves, take ownership of impactful client engagements, and develop specialized expertise in consulting and technology. Assist clients in operationalizing privacy programs by designing and implementing privacy processes, governance models, and technology-enabled solutions. Consent collection and preference management, including cookies

Our New Verticals Merchant Sentiment team ensures that when things go wrong in the last mile, there's always someone there to help. Our team creates and administers DoorDash's massive and expanding global network of support centers to provide the greatest customer experiences possible, with the ultimate goal of delivering an exceptional customer experience as efficiently and reliably as possible to our merchants.

Additionally, they actively participate in quarterly business reviews to measure and enhance Managed Merchant revenue, ensuring continuous comprehensive support and improvement.
At DoorDash, we believe in fostering a culture of meaningful connection, collaboration, and professional growth through in-office interactions. This position requires an in-office presence at the DoorDash corporate office in Tempe and the employee must live within a commutable 50 miles from the office. In-office days are determined by the business and can change based on business needs.

We are searching for a Merchant Sentiment Specialist to work with our New Vertical Merchants, both managed and unmanaged, solving their most pressing challenges and creating opportunities to improve their overall experience as we continue to scale our last-mile logistics platform.
This role will be assigned a schedule that may include evenings, weekends, and holidays. These schedules will be adjusted periodically to meet the needs of our business.

Collaborate with Account Owners weekly and troubleshoot support issues for Managed Merchants in your respective roster, including but not limited to payment issues, portal issues, menu updates, and other advanced support issues.
Take inbound contacts from Managed Merchants experiencing real-time—non-live order-related—issues ranging from account log-in support to changes of ownership and more.
Build relationships with high revenue/volume Managed Merchant partners by being the primary contact and expert for their support operations. Including participation in quarterly business reviews and other regularly occurring meetings to align on overall Merchant health
Promote retention and overall Managed Merchant success through service and proactive outreach via phone, email, or Zoom calls.
Pilot different experiences from time to time to learn how we can invest in our highest value Managed Merchants
Troubleshoot and resolve catalog and inventory issues within our internal bulk tools and Google Sheets.
Prioritize and escalate issues in partnership with internal teams
Develop expertise in how DoorDash's systems and resources work and how to use them to promote positive outcomes for our Managed Merchants
Play a key role in improving Managed Merchant experience
We’re excited about you because…
You have  3+ years of experience in a high-volume support center, customer support, or other high-volume support-related field.
Experience providing advisory and partnership-level support through both proactive and reactive interactions with end users
You are proficient with Salesforce (or other CRM software), and have the ability to view and interpret dashboards/data.
Proficient with G Suite - including GSheets/Excel
Experience with SQL/Mode is a plus
Experience in a metric-driven support environment
You excel at building cross-functional relationships and determining prioritization.
You're creative and love identifying areas where we can improve the end-user experience.
High School Diploma or GED required. Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, SF; Chicago, IL; Washington, D.C., Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, LA; Phoenix, AZ
description:
About the Team
The New Verticals team is building the future of local commerce by expanding DoorDash beyond restaurants. We help customers get the groceries, convenience items, alcohol, retail, and other essentials they need, when they need them.
The Consumer Growth team sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, product, and marketing. We identify the biggest opportunities to grow New Verticals, develop the strategies to pursue them, and bring them to life through customer-facing launches, campaigns, and product experiences.
About the Role
We’re looking for an Associate Manager to lead Consumer Growth GTM strategy for New Verticals. This person will shape how we bring priority merchants, categories, and customer behaviors to market, with a focus on bringing structure to a high volume of GTM opportunities and helping teams prioritize and execute them efficiently.
You will own the business strategy behind major growth moments: defining the customer opportunity, sizing the potential, recommending where to invest, setting goals, and translating insights into clear GTM plans. You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Business Development to ensure our plans are both strategically sound and operationally executable.
This is a highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable digging into data, developing a point of view, and driving alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders. You will manage a portfolio of initiatives with varying levels of complexity and make clear recommendations about where DoorDash should focus its limited resources for the greatest customer and business impact.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own Consumer Growth GTM strategy. Lead strategy development for priority New Verticals growth moments, including merchant launches, category expansion, seasonal occasions, affordability initiatives, and product launches. Define the customer problem, business opportunity, target audience, value proposition, and path to impact.
Set investment and customer strategy. Develop frameworks to prioritize GTM investments and determine the right level of support across initiatives. Create scalable playbooks for customer targeting, including audience strategy, targeting principles, and measurement approaches.
Turn data into action. Build analyses and models using SQL and Excel to assess customer behavior, business performance, incrementality, and return on investment. Develop test-and-learn plans and translate results into clear recommendations for what we should do next.
Lead cross-functional execution. Partner with Integrated Marketing, CRM, Paid Media, Creative, Product, Analytics, Finance, Partnerships, and Operations to bring strategies to market. Align teams on goals, audiences, measurement, timelines, risks, and decisions.
Build the operating system for GTM. Bring rigor and structure to a high volume of growth opportunities. Create clear prioritization frameworks, repeatable playbooks, planning cadences, and decision mechanisms that help teams move faster and focus resources on the highest-impact initiatives. This role rewards operational rigor: ensuring the highest-impact activations are prioritized, well scoped, and efficiently executed.
We’re excited about you because you have…
4+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, growth, business operations, product strategy, investment banking, or a related analytical and cross-functional environment.
Exceptional organizational and program-management skills. You can take a large, ambiguous set of requests and opportunities, create structure around them, and turn them into a clear, actionable plan.
Experience building scalable frameworks, playbooks, and operating processes that make cross-functional teams faster and more effective.
Strong judgment and prioritization skills. You know how to distinguish between what is urgent, what is impactful, and what does not need to happen.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust across teams, influence senior stakeholders, and navigate competing priorities with sound judgment. You know when to drive alignment, when to push back, and how to articulate a clear point of view while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
Strong analytical skills, including comfort independently pulling data in SQL and building models in Excel. You use data to develop a point of view and make clear recommendations, not just report findings.
Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
An operationally minded, low-ego approach. You are comfortable with ambiguity, willing to get into the details, and energized by bringing structure to complex work.
A completed Bachelor’s degree.
Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash because…
We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Engineer, Chassis & Vehicle Dynamic
description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike.  We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact.  We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries.  As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries.  We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better
About the Role
We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to develop and improve chassis systems and vehicle dynamics performance for DOT, DoorDash’s autonomous delivery robot. You’ll combine hands-on mechanical design, engineering analysis, and vehicle testing to improve existing platforms and develop suspension and chassis solutions for future projects.
You’ll own engineering work from requirements and concept development through detailed CAD design, prototype evaluation, and validation. Working closely with internal teams and suppliers, you’ll assess designs, resolve technical challenges, and ensure chassis systems meet our performance, durability, and integration requirements.
This role offers the opportunity to influence how DOT rides, handles, brakes, and traverses real-world terrain while improving the reliability and serviceability of our deployed robots.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Design and improve suspension and chassis systems , including suspension geometry, linkages, wheel-end assemblies, and drivetrain and brake mounting interfaces.
Own mechanical design execution , developing concepts, detailed CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, and tolerance analyses to support prototype builds and production release.
Sustain and improve existing platforms , investigating field issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing validated engineering changes.
Define chassis and vehicle dynamics requirements for ride quality, traction, braking, stability, ground clearance, and obstacle traversal across terrain and payload conditions.
Provide technical oversight of supplier-developed hardware , reviewing designs, analyses, and test results to ensure systems meet vehicle requirements and integrate successfully.
Develop and execute verification and validation plans with reliability, test, and integration teams, establishing measurable acceptance criteria for components and complete vehicles.
Lead instrumented vehicle dynamics testing , analyze results, and translate findings into hardware improvements and operating limits.
Partner with controls and autonomy engineers to characterize vehicle capabilities and improve motion performance.
Support prototype builds, manufacturing, and service teams , resolving integration issues and improving durability, manufacturability, and maintainability .
We’re excited about you because…
You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
You have experience designing and developing suspension, chassis, or related mechanical systems for vehicles or mobile robots.
You understand suspension kinematics, load transfer, tire behavior, stiffness and damping, braking, and vehicle stability—and can apply these fundamentals to hardware design.
You are proficient in NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or a comparable CAD platform and have experience releasing detailed mechanical designs.
You apply sound engineering judgment to load cases, structural integrity, fatigue, bearings, bolted joints, materials, and manufacturing processes.
You can independently assess designs and analyses, identify technical risks, and drive issues to resolution with internal teams and suppliers.
You have hands-on experience with prototype assembly, instrumentation, vehicle testing, and root cause analysis.
You can translate requirements into test methods and acceptance criteria, then use Python, MATLAB, or similar tools to evaluate results.
You take ownership from initial investigation through implementation and verification

location: New York, NY; Austin, TX; Chicago, IL; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
description:
About the Team
Our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team is re-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first-party and third-party operations businesses. DashMarts are our first-party offering designed to provide on-demand deliveries by selling household essentials, groceries, brand-name favorites, local favorites and so much more. The end to end DashMart experience is powered through DoorDash. Third-party partnerships enable us to offer on-demand deliveries from both SMB and enterprise merchants across grocery, convenience alcohol and retail storefronts. The merchants own the inventory, we fulfill and deliver them! Our Central Operations team is the heartbeat of the New Verticals Strategy & Operations team that enables us to power a robust logistic platform through a high-quality, speedy and efficient network - for both DashMarts and third party partners.
About the Role
We’re looking to hire a few Senior Associates within our Central Strategy & Operations that will help shape our strategy around delivery efficiency, leveraging both operational and product levers to build logistics systems and frameworks. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution, with end-to-end ownership of key efficiency drivers and their impact on our business. Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Finance, you will translate complex data into actionable insights and initiatives that improve efficiency, elevate the customer experience, and strengthen our bottom line. You will play a critical role in designing new systems, optimizing existing operations, and ensuring we continuously improve as we grow. We operate in a hybrid model - you will spend some time in your home office, in person via offsites and on-site in DashMarts as well. You will report into an Associate Manager on the role.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Build. You’ll have your fingerprints all over DoorDash’s next big business. You’ll do whatever it takes to launch, get 1% better every day, and scale something completely new. This means everything from high-level strategy to nitty-gritty operational details.
Test & implement. You will identify operational gaps, identify product features and test/scale those product builds in partnership with product & engineering.
Experiment. You’ll transform strategies into operational experiments that create measurable and actionable outcomes, informing your larger initiative implementation plans.
Analyze. You’ll assess the operational and financial impacts of your decisions, and iterate based on data.
Strategize . You will own and deliver on improving key selection metrics.
Lead and collaborate. You’ll work with a cross-functional team, including local operations, engineering, and product.
We’re excited about you because…
You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking. You are a self-starter. You don’t wait for others to point you at a problem. You are innately curious and take initiative to truth seek and investigate opportunities.
You’re equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you’re just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team. No job is beneath you.
You’re unafraid of ambiguity. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments
You’re analytical. You let data win arguments, and you’re comfortable pulling your own data in SQL or modeling in Excel.
You have 2-4+ years of professional experience . Ideally you have experience in strategy, product operations or business operations roles..

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

location: San Francisco, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; Seattle, WA; New York City, NY
description:
About the Team
The Reliability Platform team develops the systems that empower engineering groups across all of our brands to own the reliability of their services without needing to become reliability experts.  Our offerings enable engineers to define and measure service level objectives (SLOs), surface insights to expedite investigations and drive incidents from declaration through root-cause analysis (RCA) and postmortem. When problems are detected earlier, mitigated faster and followed up on rigorously, our engineers can ship rapidly with confidence and we can collectively ensure that the consumers, merchants and Dashers that depend on DoorDash have the best possible experience.
Reliability Platform’s long-term vision is to operationalize a flywheel of reliability data and insights in order to continually raise the bar for our global engineering organization.
About the Role
As a Software Engineer on the Reliability Platform team, you’ll help design, build, and operate software and infrastructure that deliver on the team’s mission and vision described above in collaboration with expert peers across the Infrastructure and Product organizations. You will work on mission-critical back-end services and pipelines, complex orchestration workflows, self-service platform capabilities and agentic intelligence.
We see and believe in the promise of agentic AI to radically reshape and supercharge how we serve our users and stakeholders while remaining pragmatic and committed to delivering positive business-value outcomes as the ultimate goal.
Some examples of what the Reliability Platform team does:
Own and drive unification of incident management process and tooling globally across all DoorDash-owned brands
Create the framework that measures SLO compliance and quality across tens of thousands of endpoints and derive the programmatic insights that ensure engineering teams are informed and accountable for the quality of their products
Build the internal SRE Agent used in incidents which supports team/domain-specific knowledge bases and obviates legacy runbooks
Set up MCP for agentic use of Reliability Platform data + tools and enable other Core Infra teams to follow suit
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Deliver Innovative Capabilities: You don’t want to ‘turn the crank’ somewhere, but you want to contribute to strategic thinking and help us drive meaningful continuous improvement.
Be Customer Obsessed: We want to learn from our internal customers to ensure we are solving the right challenges, and also share our perspective to influence in areas of expertise
Hold a High Quality Bar: We need to lead by example in how we develop, build, test and ship our products to show that we can work at high velocity without sacrificing quality outcomes.
Automate Everything: Your first instinct is to ask how toil can be obviated or, failing that, automated away from humans.
Shape the Future of Operations: Experiment with agentic AI workflows that can propose, validate, and safely execute production changes — moving DoorDash toward proactive, self-healing systems in step with industry first movers.
We’re excited about you because you have…
Platform Engineering Mindset: You think in terms of APIs, abstractions, and workflows — you enjoy building systems that other engineers depend on every day.
Proven Experience: You have 2+ years of experience in an infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering role, showing you can deliver and maintain complex systems.
Backend Development Skills: You’re fluent in Go (or a similar language) and can design and deliver mission-critical services that are scalable, resilient, performant, and efficient.
Cloud/Infra Expertise: You’re comfortable with AWS primitives, security best practices, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.
SRE Experience: You understand concepts like SLOs, error budgets, and incident response though this is a platform development team, not an SRE/oncall team.
AI Alignment: You embrace the use of AI tools to be a more productive and capable engineer. This applies to coding, planning, supporting peers, and everything you do.
Curiosity About the Future: You’re excited about automation and agentic, AI-assisted operations and want to help shape how engineers interact with production systems.

This is the layer where strategy becomes execution: the Director owns a defined territory sales plan and a team of quota-carrying AEs, and personally engages the most strategic customers.

The Director coaches the team to sell the full solution (Custom, Configurable, and Standard components), expanding share of wallet in the installed base and building durable, consultative relationships with plant and engineering leadership. Build, lead, coach, and scale a high-performing squad of 6–8 field account executives and sales support across a defined territory.

Embed the MEDDPICC-based discovery and qualification framework in everyday deal management.

description:

Fortune Brands is hiring a Product Manager to lead the Valve and Cartridge product line within our Moen water brand.
Every Moen faucet, shower, and bath product depends on a valve or cartridge to assembly effortlessly, seal perfectly, and provide the ideal tactile feel over years of use. This core technology serves as the foundation for our water control systems. As Product Manager , you will play a critical role in generating the growth and success of Valves and Cartridges and, consequently, Moen water products as a whole.
You will shape product strategies by aligning product offerings, channels, and pricing in ways that meet both customer and business needs. You propose strategic direction, drive the roadmap, and watch your decisions show up on shelves and in people’s homes.
This role calls for curiosity, empathy, and thoughtful analysis to understand market trends and customer experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to develop meaningful strategies, communicate shared goals, and contribute to outcomes that strengthen market presence over time. This entails a strong business acumen with a technical aptitude to become a SME of the inner workings of Valves and Cartridges and the products they interface with.
The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of fluid-control technologies and consumer-facing products. They can translate customer insights, competitive analysis, and technical requirements into a compelling product strategy, while partnering with engineering teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and market-leading plumbing or fluid-control solutions.
POSITION LOCATION: This is a hybrid position based in our world-class Deerfield, IL campus, with flexibility to work from home on Mondays and Fridays.
What you will be doing:
Development of strategic product plans by aligning performance, pricing, and supply chain with long-term business goals to support sustainable revenue and market growth.
Partner with cross-functional teams to guide new product development and innovation initiatives through the full stage-gate process.
Build collaborative relationships with external customers by sharing insights and helping identify opportunities for category growth.
Work closely with Revenue Growth Management, Sales, Analytics, and Finance teams to better understand channel dynamics and evaluate pricing strategies.
Contribute to go-to-market approaches by sharing perspectives and helping guide product and business decisions.
Collaborate with Operations, including Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality, to support product launches and monitor ongoing product performance.
Advocate for the voice of the customer by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, preferences, and market trends.
Communicate product strategies and priorities clearly and thoughtfully to a variety of stakeholders.
Support sales teams through training, participation in industry events, and ongoing engagement with partners and associations.
Partner with Brand, Channel Marketing, Digital, and Commercialization teams to co-create marketing materials and promotional strategies.
Review product-related communications to ensure clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
Provide training and guidance to internal teams and external partners on product offerings and updates.
Maintain regular, supportive communication with field sales teams, including occasional travel (approximately 15%).

As an electromagnetic engineer focusing on quantum chip packaging, you will be responsible for the EM modeling and validation of next-generation packages and interconnects to optimize their designs. You will use cryogenic microwave measurements and mechanical design inputs to construct high-fidelity 3D electromagnetic models for microwave packages, interconnects, and signal delivery lines. You will operate at the intersection of mechanical and electromagnetic engineering, ensuring that high-speed signals maintain integrity through complex package transitions to the qubit chip.
The full potential of quantum computing will be unlocked with a large-scale computer capable of complex, error-corrected computations. Google Quantum AI's mission is to build this computer and unlock solutions to classically intractable problems. Our roadmap is focused on advancing the capabilities of quantum computing and enabling meaningful applications.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services - Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few - with an ever-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity.
This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems . Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both.
Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet-spanning databases to near real-time scalable data warehousing to fault-tolerant datastream joining . In SRE, we flip between the fine-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day - usually surprising things - that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world.

Collaborate on the design and selection of optical systems, including lenses, cameras, illumination, and stereo configurations.
Design, implement, and maintain image analysis techniques and algorithms

Contribute to camera calibration, stereo reconstruction, and geometric correction

Balance accuracy, robustness, and execution speed for production deployment

Strong foundation in computer vision, numerical methods, optimization, and image processing.
Proven experience developing high‑performance, production‑quality software for computationally intensive applications.
Ability to prototype algorithms in Matlab and deploy production implementations in C++

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
About Intuitive Surgical
Intuitive Surgical is a global leader in minimally invasive care and innovative surgical robotics. We advance the boundaries of medical care by continually fostering an environment rich in discovery, problem-solving, and growth. Our mission is to drive better, safer outcomes for patients, care teams, and hospitals, while cultivating a culture where professionals are empowered and inspired.
Role Summary
We are seeking an exceptional Assistant General Counsel, Intellectual Property, with deep expertise in patent portfolio management, IP-related transactions, and IP counseling.
This role offers the chance to work at the intersection of some of the most exciting technologies in robotics and medtech today: robotic assisted surgery, AI, computer vision, advanced instrumentation, imaging, and digital surgery. As an in-house IP attorney, you would partner directly with world-class engineers, scientists, physicians, and business leaders to help develop IP strategy for technologies that have the potential to improve patient outcomes and transform how surgery is performed around the world.
Intuitive is entering an exciting period of growth as we continue to expand our platforms, integrate AI and digital technologies, and push the boundaries of what is possible in minimally invasive care. If you enjoy working on breakthrough technology, working closely with innovators, and seeing your work directly influence the trajectory of a business and an industry, we invite you to apply to join our dynamic team.
Primary Function of Position
The Assistant General Counsel, IP will lead and manage an active patent portfolio, including management of patent application preparation, patent prosecution, and IP strategic development to identify and protect Intuitive’s valuable innovations.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP will support a wide variety of IP-related transactional matters, including NDAs and other agreements covering collaboration, product development, and suppliers.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP will support strategic deals and investments, such as M&A and licensing, including conducting IP-related due diligence, crafting and negotiating deal agreements, and advising on IP-related deal strategies.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP will provide additional comprehensive IP-related legal support, including: litigation support (as needed), trademark protection, and trade secret protection.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP l will engage directly with engineers, scientists, management, clinical specialists, and executives, to translate technology developments into strong IP protection and support key business objectives.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP should become informed on industry trends and provide advice about industry and regulatory developments as well as development and implementation of operational and risk management processes and procedures.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP will report to the Associate General Counsel, IP Strategy, and must escalate issues, as appropriate, and partner with all legal team members.
The Assistant General Counsel, IP must represent Intuitive Surgical with external parties with professionalism and strategic insight, including customers, regulators, affiliates, and industry trade groups

Minimum of 10+ years experience in intellectual property law as a practitioner at a law firm and/or in-house legal department experience, with a substantial focus on patent prosecution.

Technical degree, professional background, and/or significant experience related to medical devices, robotics, mechanical engineering, or a related field (electrical engineering or other engineering specialties considered).
J.D. degree and membership in good standing with the California bar or eligible for immediate registration as a Registered In House Counsel “RHIC”.
Admitted to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office.
Ability to assess legal and business opportunities and risks related to IP assets in support of M&A, investment opportunities, licensing, and purchasing or selling of patent portfolios.
Exceptional communication and writing skills, able to distill complex technical and legal concepts for varied audiences.
Ability to closely manage outside counsel and control matter costs.
Willingness to travel on occasion as required.

Engaging, courageous, and self-directed, accustomed to managing with a collaborative, fact-based approach.
Collaborative, resourceful and adaptable—able to anticipate needs and navigate a rapidly changing environment.
Intellectually curious and eager to learn new areas of law and technology and apply knowledge effectively.

The Event Manager independently owns the end-to-end planning and execution of assigned US commercial marketing events, including tradeshows, conferences, customer programs, internal meetings, company events, and in-person, hybrid, or virtual experiences.The role translates marketing objectives into executable event plans and delivers a consistent, high-quality experience for internal and external audiences.
The Event Manager coordinates cross-functional partners, associations, agencies, and suppliers; manages event budgets, schedules, logistics, communications and event technology; identifies risks early; and uses established standards and post-event results to improve execution.

title: Field Service Engineer 2 - 2nd Shift
description:
This is a newly introduced shift offering at Intuitive, designed to expand our support coverage
and provide greater flexibility for our customers and teams. The role requires up to 75%
overnight travel, both within and outside your assigned territory, depending on evolving
business needs.
Second Shift FSEs will operate Monday through Friday, with working hours generally falling
between 2:00 p.m. and 11:00 p.m. This shift supports late-day procedures, extended
troubleshooting windows, and after-hours requests, ensuring seamless service across time
zones.
Weekend Traveler FSSEs will work extended shifts, typically 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Fridays
and Mondays, and either 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. or 10:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. on Saturdays and
Sundays. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and
are eager to support the mission of providing uninterrupted patient care.
Primary Function of Position
As a Field Service Engineer 2 at Intuitive, you will be an integral part of our dedicated team,
responsible for the installation, support, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of all our
products within your management designated area of responsibility. Your primary focus will be
to ensure that all service agreements and warranty obligations are met and surpassed, while consistently exceeding customer expectations. This role demands
expertise in electro-mechanical systems, acquired through
specialized training, as well as exceptional customer service and
communication skills. As a Field Service Engineer 2, you will have
the opportunity to work closely with our valued customers, providing technical expertise,
resolving issues, and delivering outstanding support. Join us in our commitment to excellence
and innovation as we continue to revolutionize the industry.
Essential Job Duties
• Understand and comply with all department and company policies
• Provide management with a quarterly review and assessment of your assigned area of
responsibility
• Proficiency in accurately documenting service activities, maintaining records, and
providing comprehensive reports to stakeholders
• Complete all administrative tasks in the required time frame
• Provide technical support to end-users and other Intuitive employees
• Conduct training sessions at Intuitive facilities, training centers, and hospitals
• Perform various scheduled maintenance activities such as system inspections,
preventive maintenance, software updates, system recalls, field actions, and upgrades
• Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair all Intuitive products and associated equipment in
accordance with procedures and within designated timeframes
• Coordinate and perform system and hardware delivery and installation
• Competent in knowledge and implementation of O.R. protocol and HIPAA standards
• Complete all administrative duties, which include, but not limited to; Spare parts
inventory, Field Activity Reports, Return Material Authorizations, Expense Reports etc.
within specified timeframes
• Maintain all Intuitive-provided items, such as issued tools, calibrated tool sets,
employee vehicles, laptops, iPads, and other company-owned assets
• Support and collaborate with Intuitive teams to facilitate company goals; eg. Assist Sales
teams with trade show support, assist Genesis teams with sterile reprocessing training,
provide hospital contacts to other Intuitive teams, etc…
• Provide feedback to HQ and take part in continuous improvement projects as required
to improve processes and identify efficiencies
• Complete all required or assigned training, including equipment training for all Intuitive
products, Intuitive Surgical University classes, and professional development courses as
directed by management

customer needs, maintaining system install base configurations, customer contacts,
establishing a rapport with assigned customer base, and providing support for customer
training and events

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a team, collaborating with
colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders to achieve common goals
• Demonstrated ability to identify, analyze, and resolve technical issues efficiently,
utilizing strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking abilities
• Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize
tasks, meet deadlines, and handle multiple assignments
simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
• Ability to Travel up to 75% and within the travel and
expense policy as required by management to fulfill the specific needs of the role
• Willingness to perform ad hoc tasks assigned by management
• Reside within a reasonable distance, typically within 30 miles, of the assigned territory
location or other designated area as required by management to fulfill the specific
needs of the role
• Ability to work a flex shift, second shift, or other type of shift as required by
management to fulfill the specific needs of the role
• Demonstrate individual characteristics expected of Intuitive personnel (eg. Character,
capacity, energy, experience)
Working Conditions
• Ability to lift 75 lbs. and move wheeled objects up to 1,200 lbs.
• Clean driving record
• Ability to obtain and maintain Vendor Credentialing approval for access to operating
rooms
• Compliance with all necessary vaccination requirements as mandated by the vendor
credentialing process

• Minimum 1-3 years of Field Service Experience preferred
• Minimum of an Associate’s degree in related field or equivalent training/experience
preferred

• Good written and oral communication skills

• Comfortable working off hours with limited support
• Excellent administrative and record keeping skills

Lead a team to maintain work standards using time studies across all operational processes
Creates effective team environment, mentor, influence and demonstrate leadership model worth emulating
Partner with IE managers from other Business Units (BU) and sites for evaluating corporate initiatives impacting IE; lead implementation within their assigned BU
Partner with Data Science/Analytics teams to address manufacturing data gaps to ensure all aspects of factory performance are being measured on time
Evaluate new software/tools with a goal of implementing when there is a clear benefit to IE or Manufacturing Operations.  Work with leadership to socialize and ultimately implement across the business

Minimum BS degree in an engineering discipline (i.e. IE, EE, ME)

Well versed with data systems (SAP, SAP HANA, Snowflake, and O9) and data manipulation and reporting packages (Tableau, Excel)
Track record of being able to drive process and cultural change
Minimal travel required (estimate 0-5%)

Ability to overcome obstacles to drive change and resolve problems
Working understanding of GMP and GDP practices and requirements

Facility design and construction management experienced

Real Estate Portfolio Strategy

description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic-assisted surgery.
If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
The Future Forward group within Intuitive Surgical is searching for a Mechanical Engineer to help design the endoscope system for a novel robotic surgical platform. As an early member of the team, this role is an exciting opportunity to help define the eventual product from early prototypes through clinical trials and into product launch.
Essential Job Duties
As part of the New Product Development team, the engineer will work with team members to:
Distal Tip and Vision Mechanical Design
Own the mechanical design of the endoscope distal tip and camera module, including housings, optical windows, lens and image-sensor mounts, illumination (LED and/or fiber-optic) integration, and sealing features
Design miniature, high-precision machined, injection-molded / micro-molded, and MIM components; perform tolerance stack-up analysis to achieve tight optical alignment and high assembly yield
Select materials, adhesives, and joining processes (e.g., precision bonding, laser welding, soldering) compatible with biocompatibility, sterilization, and reliability requirements
Prototyping, Test, and Supplier Development
Rapidly build, assemble, and test prototypes; analyze results and drive fast design iterations
Apply FEA and other modeling and simulation methods (structural, thermal, sealing) to key design elements and use results to inform design decisions
Design tooling and fixtures for assembly, optical alignment, and test
Work with suppliers to take parts from quick-turn prototypes to production-intent components, driving DFM/DFA, quality, and cost
Requirements, Documentation, and Design Controls
Translate system and user needs into mechanical requirements and specifications; contribute to risk management activities (e.g., dFMEA)
Create detailed drawings with GD&T and document designs, test protocols, and reports under design controls (ISO 13485, FDA QMSR / 21 CFR 820)
Support design verification, clinical builds, and design transfer to manufacturing
Generate and evaluate concepts for next-generation endoscopic and vision devices
Electro-Mechanical and Thermal Integration
Partner with electrical engineers to package flex / rigid-flex circuits, micro-coax cables, and connectors through the tip and shaft, managing bend radius, strain relief, and EMI shielding
Perform thermal analysis (first-principles calculations and simulation) of the tip and camera module; design heat-spreading paths and heat sinks so that image sensors, patient-contacting surfaces remain within component and IEC 60601 temperature limits
Plan and execute thermal characterization tests (e.g., thermocouples, IR thermography) and correlate results with models
Required Skills and Experience
4+ years of industry experience designing and delivering complex, precision mechanical assemblies (or 1+ years with an PhD)
Hands-on experience building, assembling, and testing prototypes and complex mechanical assemblies
Proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks strongly preferred) and detailed drawing creation
Working knowledge of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) / ISO drafting standards and tolerance stack-up analysis
Experience applying FEA and first-principles engineering analysis to the design of mechanical parts
Experience designing for machining and injection molding, and working directly with suppliers
Strong communication and documentation skills; proven ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, cross-functional team
Preferred Skills and Experience (Strong Plus)
Electro-mechanical system design: integrating PCBAs, flex / rigid-flex circuits, cabling, connectors, sensors, or actuators into compact mechanical packages
Thermal analysis and thermal management: heat-transfer calculations, heat sink / heat spreader sizing, and thermal simulation (e.g., ANSYS Icepak / Fluent, Simcenter FloTHERM, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Flow Simulation), with correlation to test data
Medical device development experience, particularly endoscopes, catheters, or other minimally invasive instruments, under ISO 13485 design controls
Knowledge of biocompatible materials (ISO 10993), sterilization / reprocessing methods, and sealing / ingress protection
Experience with micro-manufacturing processes such as Swiss-type machining, micro-molding, MIM, laser welding, and precision adhesive bonding
Familiarity with IEC 60601-1 and IEC 60601-2-18 (endoscopic equipment)
Scripting for data analysis or test automation (e.g., Python, MATLAB)
Required Education and Training
· BS in Mechanical Engineering or closely related field

title: Senior Biosafety Engineer
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position:
Intuitive Surgical designs and manufactures pioneering medical devices for use in surgery. These devices consist of surgical instruments, endoscopes, diagnostic tools, and accessories used on a robotic surgical platform. Each patient-contact device is evaluated for biological safety according to relevant international standards.  The Biological Safety Group at Intuitive are responsible for the definition, implementation, and communication of our biological safety program under the guidance of board-certified toxicologists.
The Biosafety Development Engineer is responsible for managing and collaborating with teams in support of the biological safety evaluation process for new products and changes to existing products. The successful candidate must excel in a high-energy, small-focused team environment, be a quick learner, and have a commitment to high product quality. The candidate must have a strong understanding of toxicology and analytical chemistry requirements for evaluating the biological safety of medical devices. The candidate should possess experience in designing and implementing biocompatibility safety evaluations, risk assessments, root-cause analysis, laboratory techniques, in vitro and in vivo test methods, and chemical analyses. The candidate should have experience in planning, tracking, creating process and procedure and implementing activities for the biological safety evaluation of medical devices, adhering to ISO 10993 guidelines. The candidate should have understating and knowledge of global regulatory requirements, compliance, quality management systems, audits, standards, and test methods for the biological safety evaluation and risk assessment of medical devices.
A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required and the ability to make work fun and interesting.  Supporting you will be a technical services management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Work closely with toxicologists and other specialists to support and implement the biological safety program at Intuitive; collaborate with biosafety group members to develop safety assessment plans.
Serve as the biological safety representative for new product development teams; attend meetings; communicate schedules; present at design reviews; and be responsible for peer interactions with engineering. With excellent organizational skills, prioritization abilities, and effective communication with project stakeholders, play a crucial role in managing multiple projects concurrently, ensuring the fulfillment of all compliance requirements.
Responsible for closely monitoring and ensuring that all processes and procedures are in line with the biocompatibility requirements set by relevant regulatory bodies. This includes conducting assessments, reviewing documentation, and implementing necessary changes to achieve compliance.
Support sustaining and supplier engineering programs by collecting information on design changes for patient-contact materials and coordinating the execution of biological safety assessment plans.
Responsible for continuously reviewing and updating biological safety processes and procedures based on current standards. This includes staying informed about the latest regulatory requirements and industry best practices to ensure our standards remain accurate and up to date.
Create and maintain project management tools to track biological safety activities and communicate progress on commitments to project leaders and business unit executives.
Responsible for establishing and maintaining a comprehensive tracking system for all compliance-related projects. This includes documenting project progress, milestones, and any necessary updates or changes. Ensure that all project documentation is easily accessible to the relevant stakeholders.
Engage directly with project stakeholders to address any requirements, processes, or compliance-related inquiries. able to effectively communicate complex information in a clear and concise manner will be crucial to ensuring a smooth compliance process.
Support biosafety plans, coordinate chemical characterization and biocompatibility testing activities at CRO laboratories; understand testing needs; request quotes; coordinate test articles; and track schedules.
Support the creation and archiving of documentation that supports the biological safety of intuitive products; write reports and release them in the document management system (Agile)
Maintain an ISI biological safety material database and provide computer-generated reports as needed.
Assist engineering teams in choosing patient-contact materials based on prior usage, and assist in describing design, material, process, and supplier modifications for biosafety evaluation.
The role involves supporting regulatory filing activities, including FDA 510(k) submissions (and other filing strategies), OUS country registration activities, MDR compliance certification, and other regulatory support needs.
Develop a working understanding of medical device biocompatibility, including relevant national and international standards, methods for biosafety end-point testing, and other regulatory requirements.
Skill/Job Requirements:
A minimum bachelor's degree in medical life science or engineering, or a master's degree, is preferred.
8+ years of experience in medical device product safety, product development, or related areas
Nice to Have:
Training in medical device biocompatibility testing and management, or an equivalent program, is preferred.
Proven project management skills: PMP certification is a plus.
Strong organizational and interpersonal skills are essential for working effectively in a team environment.
In vitro and in vivo laboratory testing experience is preferred but can be acquired through training.
Knowledge of MS Office applications

description:
