Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About the role:
This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.
This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware.  The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
Minimum requirements for this role:
2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts , Rhode Island, Connecticut, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Washinton DC, Maryland, Delaware
An ideal candidate has:
Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
Experience with high-volume cold calling
Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
SFDC familiarity
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual OTE Salary $152,000 — $190,000 USD Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here .

About the role:
The Commercial Customer Success team supports hundreds to thousands of customers who depend on the Samsara platform daily. This team is dedicated to equipping every customer with the necessary resources to achieve rapid value, regardless of their background or expertise.
To scale this impact, we are seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager, AI & Automation to be a hands-on developer responsible for designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems to support a digital-first post-sales strategy.
Key responsibilities include:
Customer Journey Optimization: Pinpoint friction points in the customer experience, create proactive interventions, and turn interactions into automated, personalized journeys.
End-to-End Execution: Write code, execute experimental tests, and continuously maintain production solutions.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner across teams to ensure a cohesive experience for all users.
Success is measured by key customer outcome metrics, including increased adoption, minimized churn risk, and higher NRR tied to the agents you deploy.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.
You should apply if:
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
In this role, you will:
Analyze: Identify customer painpoints and areas of opportunity with an analytical mindset combined with a customer-centric lens.
Build: Build the digital CS playbooks, taking advantage of the programs and resources other teams have built, design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), build guardrails, and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.
Test: Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes.
Deploy: Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production-ready before they reach CSMs. Ensure anything we deploy makes the experience more simple, not more complex, for our customers.
Monitor: Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong.
Maintain & Iterate: Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Minimum requirements for the role:
Hands-on experience building and maintaining production LLM-based agents or automations, with at least 1 year working directly with LLMs or AI agents in production
Ability to code rapidly with Python proficiency or skilled at using AI to code; have a track record of connecting AI to external systems: CRMs, APIs, customer data, and operational tools
Experience using product usage data to spot risk and opportunity (health signals, activation milestones, usage floors) and acting on it before it surfaces in a renewal conversation
Comfort running experiments and drawing sound conclusions from the data in order to improve the performance
A systems mindset for managing a high-volume book of business: you build repeatable playbooks and motions, not just manage individual relationships
3+ years of experience, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment
An ideal candidate also has:
Direct experience with Anthropic Claude or similar LLM APIs
Experience building programs to support NRR, retention, or expansion outcomes on a digital or long-tail book of business (100+ accounts)
Experience building regression test suites or eval frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems
Experience in a product-led or high-velocity customer environment
WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW
You’ll be first. This function doesn’t exist yet. You’ll define the role, the standard, and the playbook for digital customer success at Samsara.
The problem is real. A CSM managing 350+ accounts can’t do everything manually. Digital and agentic motions are what make this segment sustainable at Samsara’s scale.
The timing is right. The models have caught up to the use cases, and Samsara has the customer data, platform context, and Customer Success team to make these systems genuinely powerful.

title: Business Operations Generalist
description:
COMPANY BACKGROUND

Specter's mission is to help automate the physical world.

Today, we build video sensors with state-of-the-art AI agents that answer any question, anywhere in their environments. Our systems can automatically detect and reason about any physical activity captured on camera, from security incidents (e.g. perimeter intrusion, theft, LPR), to safety monitoring (e.g. PPE detection, injured people), to operational efficiency (e.g. material tracking, congestion monitoring). We offer both long range wireless (1km range) and wired sensor variants to suit any deployment.

Our co-founders Xerxes and Philip are passionate about empowering our partners in the fast approaching world of physical AI and robotics. We are a small, fast growing team who hail from Anduril, Tesla, Uber, and the U.S. Special Forces.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Business Operations Generalist to join Specter's lean BizOps team. This person will work across deal support, pricing, market strategy, planning, finance, and company systems. Today the work leans more commercial, including working with our GTM teams on sales materials, customer value cases, and proposals. In a given week, it can mean a customer business case one day and a CRM cleanup the next. Some of it is strategic. Some of it is unglamorous. Part of the job is building the templates and systems that make that work repeatable, so the role will likely look different in 6 months, and may be less GTM oriented then. We want someone who enjoys that variety, jumps into new problems as they come up, owns the outcome, and leaves each process better than they found it. The right person is analytical, commercially sharp, highly organized, and comfortable working with leadership, sales, finance, product, and engineering in the same day.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - You will put together pricing, proposals, customer business cases, and value models for complex deals, and support contract review. Over time, you will turn this work into templates and systems the sales team can run on their own.

 - You will build business cases for new markets and new products, and keep the team current on what competitors are doing.

 - You will help leadership and the sales team see the pipeline clearly through forecasting, CRM hygiene, and dashboards.

 - You will support planning, budgeting, and board and investor reporting, and track spend across the business, including production, R&D, SaaS, and vendor spend.

 - You will build processes, documentation, and decision frameworks where today there may only be spreadsheets, Slack threads, and ad hoc decisions.

 - You will handle the day-to-day work that keeps the business running: cleaning up data, coordinating vendors, chasing down numbers, and taking problems from "someone should figure this out" to a clear owner and outcome.
   
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3 to 5 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or investing, or in business operations, revenue operations, or a similarly analytical role at an early-stage, high-growth startup.

 - Strong with spreadsheets and financial models, and comfortable in a CRM.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Good judgment and the ability to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

 - A low-ego team player who takes on the detailed, behind-the-scenes work without being asked and improves it over time.

Customers include Sunoco, Lockheed Martin, NASA, and the U.S. Army, along with hundreds of manufacturers nationwide. Standard Bots raised a $200 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation from RoboStrategy, General Catalyst, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, and Samsung Next.


About the role

Fabricators across the country can't hire enough welders, and you know it better than most, because you've run a torch yourself. As our Welding Sales Manager, you'll show shops what cobot welding does for their throughput, quality, and people, and you'll own the national welding number. Welding is one of our fastest-growing applications, and you'll be the person who helps it grow even faster.


📍 Location

This role is remote within the United States, and we prefer candidates in NYC metro, North Carolina, California, Illinois or Texas. Expect to travel frequently to customer sites, regional teams, trade shows, and partners (~50% domestic travel).


What you'll do

- Own the welding number. You carry the national quota for welding systems and revenue across direct and partner sales. You build and manage the welding pipeline and forecast with each region, and you measure success by installed, producing systems, not just bookings.

- Partner with Regional Sales Managers. You co-sell welding opportunities with RSMs in every territory, from discovery through close. That means welding-specific discovery, part and joint reviews, and ROI conversations with fabricators. You'll join customer site visits, demos, and weld trials alongside our Welding Applications Engineers, and you'll raise the welding knowledge of the broader sales team through training, deal reviews, and ride-alongs.

- Sell direct MIG welding systems. You help shops evaluate cobot MIG welding against their part mix, volumes, and labor constraints, and you lead the proposals, pricing, and negotiation on welding deals.

- Build the partner channel. You recruit and manage gas and welding distributors as a lead source for Standard Bots welding. You also support partner-built solutions, such as laser welding cells, from the first conversation to repeatable sales.

- Be the voice of the welding customer. You bring field feedback on ease of use, features, and competitive gaps to the welding product team, and you represent Standard Bots at welding and fabrication trade shows and industry events.


What you'll bring

- Hands-on welding experience. You've laid beads and you know what a good weld looks like. MIG is required; TIG or laser is a plus.

- 5+ years in welding sales or welding applications, ideally robotic or automated welding.

- A track record of closing capital equipment deals with manufacturers and fabricators.

- Comfort working as an individual contributor who leads through influence across regional sales teams.

- Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites, trade shows, and partner meetings.


Nice to have

- Experience with a welding OEM, welding distributor, or robotic welding integrator.

- Existing relationships with gas and welding distributors.

- AWS certification (CW, CWI, or similar).

- Experience building or managing a channel partner program.

The on target earnings (OTE) range for this role is $190,000 - $225,000, depending on experience. We are open to a variety of seniority levels for this role and will build compensation packages that are commensurate with seniority and skill level. description:

Summary of Key Responsibilities
Functional Design & Product Documentation
Own the functional design specifications and product backlog across the AI-enabled sourcing platform — you are the author and accountable party for specs that engineering builds from directly:
Translate sourcing and procurement workflows (calendaring, market intelligence, contract management, commodity analysis) into clear, engineer-ready product requirements

sample data, field mappings, and system-of-record decisions is an immediate priority
Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, demos, retrospectives); manage the cross-module sprint backlog alongside the Principal Engineer
Participate in UAT and AI output reviews — you hold the bar on whether a release is ready for stakeholders

Familiarity with enterprise procurement platforms (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle, Jaggaer, or similar)

Excellent written communication — your PRDs, status updates, and decision logs are things people actually read
Experience partnering with data, finance, and legal as internal customers or reviewers
Comfortable presenting to both technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders, adjusting depth accordingly
Nice to Have
Experience as a PM or analyst at a CPG, retail, foodservice, or global supply chain organization
Prior work on AI-enabled enterprise products (not just traditional SaaS)
Familiarity with engineering delivery metrics (e.g. deployment frequency, lead time, incident rate) and how they inform product and roadmap decisions

3–6 years of product management or product analyst experience, with at least 1–2 years in a technically complex or AI-adjacent product environment

title: Account Executive, Velocity Platforms (Hunter)
location: Chicago, IL; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Lightspeed and Mindbody.
As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations.
What you’ll do
As an Account Executive (New Business), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.
Responsibilities
Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise companies
Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating touchpoints with Stripe executives
Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models
Develop and execute outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities
Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for Startup, SMB and mid-market platforms
Coordinate and support the implementation for sold platforms and ramp for their usage of Stripe products
Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help provide product feedback
Who you are
You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with Startup, SMB and Mid-Market companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.
If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!
Minimum requirements
2+ years of sales or prospecting experience, preferably at a technology company, with a track record of top performance
Ability to understand complex technical ecosystems and build great relationships with technical customers
Analytical ability to manage complex sales cycles, directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance
Experience managing projects with input from cross-functional teams, including managing user deployments and ramp timelines
A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
Ability and motivation to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
Superior verbal and written communication skills
Proven ability to close deals, manage a full sales cycle and meet or exceed sales targets
Payments experience is preferred

About the team
Radar helps businesses prevent payments fraud and abuse while enabling legitimate customers to transact with confidence. We combine machine learning and AI with the intelligence of Stripe’s global network to make sophisticated fraud prevention accessible to businesses of all sizes.
Our work spans payments fraud detection, protection against abuse beyond the payment, enterprise APIs that bring Radar’s capabilities into businesses’ own systems and payment flows, and the platform that powers it all. We build everything from reliable, low-latency infrastructure to intuitive tools that help users understand threats and control how they respond.
Fraud evolves constantly, and so do we. We work directly with users to understand emerging attacks, turn advances in ML and AI into effective defenses, and build products that protect and grow their revenue.
What you’ll do
As a software engineer on Radar, you’ll build products and infrastructure that help businesses understand and stop fraud and abuse. Your work will span backend services, enterprise APIs, and user experiences that put sophisticated prevention capabilities into our customers’ hands.
You’ll own problems from investigation through launch, partnering with  product managers, designers, and data scientists. You’ll have opportunities to scale systems that make real-time decisions across Stripe’s global payments network, bring advances in ML and AI into production, and build new products from scratch. Every improvement can have a direct impact on the revenue our users retain and the legitimate customers they serve.
Responsibilities
Build and operate reliable, low-latency services that detect and prevent fraud and abuse at scale
Design APIs and dashboard experiences that help businesses investigate threats, configure defenses, and understand how Radar protects them
Develop the shared platform and infrastructure that enable teams to build and launch new Radar capabilities
Work directly with users to understand emerging threats and turn those insights into broadly useful products
Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to bring new signals, models, and AI capabilities into production
Own projects end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and iteration
Uphold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and product craft while moving quickly as threats evolve

An ownership mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity, taking initiative, and following through on user problems

Experience building APIs, developer platforms, or intuitive user interfaces for complex workflows
Experience bringing ML or AI capabilities into production software
Experience working on fraud prevention, abuse prevention, risk, or security
Experience taking a product from an early idea to launch and iterating directly with customers

  • Model the inputs to orchestration (rider demand, data-collection value, servicing needs, events, and policies) as objectives and constraints

  • Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust; you write clean, tested, version-controlled code
  • Ability to turn ambiguous real-world problems into well-defined models and explain the tradeoffs to non-specialists
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

  • Publications in operations research, transportation, or robotics venues

Job Description:
The Talent Acquisition Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and managing the day-to-day operational activities of the Talent Acquisition function. The role oversees recruiting-related invoicing and vendor administration, conducts audits of background screening, advertising spend, and referral programs, serves as a primary liaison between Talent Acquisition and external partners such as Indeed, and provides administrative support throughout the hiring process as needed. This individual identifies and resolves operational issues, ensures compliance with established processes, maintains accurate records and reporting, and supports recruiters and hiring managers with onboarding, offer administration, and other recruiting operations activities as needed. The role is critical to maintaining process efficiency, financial accuracy, vendor accountability, and a positive hiring experience for candidates, recruiters, and business stakeholders.
The Talent Acquisition Coordinator enables efficient, compliant, and cost-effective recruiting operations by managing critical administrative, vendor, financial, and process activities that support the Talent Acquisition team. This role serves as the operational backbone of the recruiting function, ensuring recruiting systems, vendors, invoices, audits, and hiring processes run smoothly so recruiters can focus on attracting and hiring talent.
Financial Administration
Manage all Talent Acquisition vendor invoicing and payment processing, ensuring invoices are accurate, approved, and submitted on time.
Track and reconcile recruiting-related expenditures, including advertising spend, vendor costs, and other Talent Acquisition investments.
Assist with budget tracking, spend reporting, and invoice audit activities to ensure financial accuracy and accountability.
Vendor & Partner Management
Serve as the operational contact for recruiting vendors, including Indeed and background screening providers.
Coordinate issue resolution, billing inquiries, account administration, and ongoing vendor support activities.
Monitor recruiting vendor performance and support optimization efforts.
Audits & Compliance
Administer the employee referral bonus program, including eligibility verification and payment coordination.
Conduct audits of background checks, recruiting spend, invoices, referral bonus payments, and other recruiting activities to ensure accuracy, compliance, and appropriate controls.
Maintain recruiting records and documentation in accordance with company policies and procedures.
Recruiting Operations Support
Serve as a central resource for recruiting operations questions, process guidance, and administrative support.
Provide offer and onboarding support during periods of high hiring volume or recruiter capacity constraints, assisting candidates through offer acceptance, pre-employment requirements, and onboarding activities to ensure a smooth transition into the business.
Reporting & Process Improvement
Produce and maintain recruiting operational reports and records.
Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve data accuracy, and reduce administrative burden for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates.
Support implementation of process improvements, system enhancements, and operational best practices.
Education:
Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Education, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field preferred.
Experience:
Minimum of 2 years of experience in recruiting coordination, human resources, talent acquisition operations, payroll, finance, or administrative support.
Experience managing invoices, budgets, expense tracking, or vendor payments.
Experience working with external vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and ensure service delivery.
Experience maintaining accurate records, conducting audits, and supporting compliance-related processes.
Experience supporting high-volume administrative processes in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with talent acquisition processes, recruiting systems, or onboarding activities preferred
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data tracking, analysis, and reporting.
Experience working with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HR systems, and vendor management platforms preferred.
Ability to manage invoicing, expense reconciliation, and financial tracking processes.
Ability to perform audits, identify discrepancies, and ensure data accuracy.
Strong reporting and record management capabilities.
Ability to learn and navigate multiple systems and technologies simultaneously.

Customer Focus – Provides responsive and professional support to recruiters, hiring managers, candidates, and vendors.
Problem Solving – Identifies issues, recommends solutions, and follows through to resolution.
Collaboration – Builds productive working relationships across teams and with external partners.
